-- name test_v8trade
-- type Spark SQL
-- author wanghk@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2023-11-22 11:00:06
-- desc 



--   insert overwrite table base_app_cisp.t_cisp_y8_busi partition(biz_month)
  SELECT
       ${bdp.system.premonth} fmonth,
       A.branch_code,
       A0.LN1B,A0.LN1E,
       nvl(A1.LN2B,0) ln2B,nvl(A1.LN2E,0) ln2E,
       A0.LN1B-nvl(A1.LN2B,0) LN3B,A0.LN1E-nvl(A1.LN2E,0) LN3E,
       A2.LN4B,A2.LN4E,
       B.LN5B,B.LN5E,
       nvl(C.LN7B,0)+nvl(D.LN8B,0) LN6B,nvl(C.LN7E,0)+nvl(D.LN8E,0) LN6E,
       C.LN7B,C.LN7E,
       NVL(D.LN8B,0) LN8B,NVL(D.LN8E,0) LN8E,
       I.LN9E,
       I.LN10E,
       I.LN11E,
       nvl(C.LN13E,0)+nvl(D.LN14E,0) AS LN12E,
       C.LN13E,
       nvl(D.LN14E,0) LN14E,
       A0.LN22B+H.LN23B LN21B,A0.LN22E+G.LN23E LN21E,
       A0.LN22B,A0.LN22E,
       H.LN23B,G.LN23E,
       h.fzje,g.fzje,   --  比例在查询时根据担保价值和负债金额进行计算获取
       CC.LN25B,CC.LN25E,
       h.LN21B,g.LN21E,
       ${bdp.system.premonth} as biz_month
 FROM 
(select trim(bran_entry_value) BRANCH_CODE,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=35 and entry_code ='9901') A
left join 
 (
-- /*期末信用资金账户数 */
SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
        SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1E,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1B,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  THEN
              T.zjye ELSE 0
           END) AS LN22B,   --  期初资金
       SUM(CASE
                 WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
                  T.ZJYE ELSE 0
               END) AS LN22E    --  期末资金
  FROM base_app_cisp.TB_RZRQ_TZJZHTJ T
 WHERE T.KHFLFS in(0, 1)
   AND T.RQ IN (${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}, ${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
   AND T.ZHLB = 2
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) A0 on a.BRANCH_CODE=a0.BRANCH_CODE
   left join
   (
   select A.BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2E,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2B
        from (SELECT branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no as capital_account,
               min(cap_acct_state_code) as bal_status,
               min(open_date) as bal_opendate,
               min(CLOSE_date) as bal_closedate
          from base_data.tac_cap_acct 
          group by branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no) a
        join 
        (select a.cust_no, b.cap_acct_no as capital_account,a.branch_code
                From base_data.tpt_cust a
                join base_data.tac_cap_acct b on (b.ACCT_ATTR_CODE =2 and a.cust_no =b.cust_no)
                where a.cust_type_code = 1) b on (a.branch_code=b.branch_code and a.capital_account=b.capital_account)
      GROUP BY A.BRANCH_CODE
   )a1 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A1.BRANCH_CODE
   left join
   (
   select BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4E,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4B
        from base_app_cisp.tb_rzrq_tzqzhtj b
      where b.rq in(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})
      and b.khflfs in(1,0)
      GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   )a2 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A2.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5E,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5B  --  ,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
  left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE T.RQ IN ( ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) B ON A.BRANCH_CODE=B.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7E,   --  其中:融资余额 期末,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7B,   --  其中:融资余额 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzje               ELSE 0 END ) AS LN13E   --  其中:融资授信金额  期末
      FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczjtj T1
      left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t1.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE  T1.RQ <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) C ON A.BRANCH_CODE=C.BRANCH_CODE
left join
(
SELECT  t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25E,   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31')  and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25B   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_khlxtj T1 ,(select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=35 and entry_code ='9901') t2
 WHERE T1.yyb=t2.bran_entry_value and 
   T1.rq <= concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
   GROUP BY t2.entry_value
   ) CC ON A.BRANCH_CODE=CC.BRANCH_CODE
  LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8E,   --  其中:融券市值 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8B,   --  其中:融券市值 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq > ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN brrqje ELSE 0 END) AS LN14E   --  其中:融资授信金额
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczqtj T
 WHERE T.tx_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.tx_date>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
   and T.qsrq <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.qsrq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) D ON A.BRANCH_CODE=D.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zzc else 0 end ),0) AS LN21E,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23E,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.rq = CASE WHEN ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} =20200123 THEN 20200131 ELSE ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} END
   and t.rq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) G ON A.BRANCH_CODE=G.BRANCH_CODE
 LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then ZZC else 0 end),0) AS LN21B,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23B,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.tx_date =${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} and t.rq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY yyb
   ) H  ON A.BRANCH_CODE=H.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN
( SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
           COUNT(cust_no) AS LN9E, 
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '61' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN10E,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '64' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN11E
  FROM base_data.tev_sett_crdt T
 WHERE T.biz_date >${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  and  t.biz_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   AND TRIM(T.busi_subj) IN ('61', '64')
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
) I ON A.BRANCH_CODE=I.BRANCH_CODE
;

t.yyb AS src_branch_code,
COALESCE(M_20007.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.JYS)) AS TX_MARKET_CODE,

T.CXWTH AS REVOKE_ENTR_NO,

T.ZQMC AS SEC_NAME,
--COALESCE(M_30001.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.ZQLB)) AS SEC_TYPE_CODE,

COALESCE(M_40002.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.DDLX)) AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE,

T.YJ AS COMM_AMT,
T.WTGY AS OPER_TELLER,
COALESCE(M_40007.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.WTFS)) AS ENTR_MODE_CODE,
T.CZZD AS OPER_SITE,
regexp_replace(
case 
--1.1有mac字样开头，考虑存在中间分隔符或者不存在两张情况，末尾必须有分隔符或者字符尾
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',2)
--1.2无mac字样开头，考虑中间有分隔符号: (00:00:00:00:00:00  考虑：-|.和空格),并且前后有分隔符（标点、空格、开头和结尾）
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0)
--1.3无mac字样开头，考虑中间无分隔符号，排除UUID造成的影响
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
     and regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)<>
         regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',8)
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0)
else ''
end,
'[\\s\\pP\\W]','') as OPER_site_mac,
CASE
--2.1 IP判断有固定前缀的认为他准确
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE
--2.2 IP内网包含10网段 172,16-31,192.168
regexp_extract(
regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),--剔除10,127,172,192,255网段
'((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(([1-9]|1[1-9]|[2-9][0-9]|11[0-9]|12[012345689]|1[3-6][0-9]|17[013456789]|18[0-9]|19[013456789]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-4])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((172)[.]([1]?[0-5]|[3][2-9]|[4-9][0-9]|25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2})[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((192)[.]([1-9]?[0-9]|1[0-5][0-9]|16[012345679]|1[7-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))'
,0)
,'(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)',0)
end as OPER_site_ip,
case 
--3.1手机号优先判断有前缀的记录
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN:)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',7)
--3.2手机号只考虑有前后分隔符
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
END AS OPER_site_MOBILE,
case 
--4.1硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种[;,]
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',6)
else ''
end as OPER_site_hd,
case 
--5.1 ios的uuid考虑有uuid开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_UUID,
case
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 or length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN 'HH'

WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
when t.czzd rlike '^(172|10|192).\\d+.\\d+.\\d+$'
then '6'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%DZHG%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN 'DZHGB'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%SFJR%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN '3'
when (upper(t.czzd) like '%GSFY%' OR upper(t.czzd) like '%股市方圆%') AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA' 
THEN 'GSFY'
WHEN T.WTFS='8' --OR upper(t.czzd) like '%127.0.0.1%'
THEN '4'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
else ''
END AS OPER_SOURCE,
COALESCE(M_40008.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.DDLB)) AS ENTR_TYPE_CODE,
T.JYLB AS BUSI_SUBJ,
FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP()) AS BIZ_TIME,
'MDA5' AS BIZ_SRC

AND M_40001.PREV_SYS = 'MDA5'
--LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_30001
--ON T.ZQLB = M_30001.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
--AND M_30001.DICT_ENTRY = '30001'
--AND M_30001.PREV_SYS = 'MDA5'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40002

LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_20005

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE CRM.T_CUST_MID SELECT * FROM CRM.T_CUST_MID_TEMP;

INSERT INTO CRM.PROC_RUN_MESSAGES
  (PROC_NAME, TARGET_SCHEMA, RUN_MSG, RUN_DATE)
VALUES
  ('CRM_T_CUST_MID_HIVE', 'CRM', '准备加工crm.T_CUST_MID', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP());

MERGE into crm.T_CUST_MID tc
    using (
         SELECT T1.YYB
               ,T1.KHH
               ,T1.KHJC
               ,T1.KHMC
               ,T1.KHLB
               ,T1.ZJLB
               ,T1.ZJBH
               ,T1.ZJQSRQ
               ,T1.ZJJZRQ
               ,T1.KHRQ
               ,CASE T1.XHRQ WHEN '0' THEN ''
               WHEN '19000101' THEN '' ELSE T1.XHRQ END XHRQ
               ,T1.KHZT
               ,T1.XYDJ
               ,T1.SJ
               ,CASE T2.XB WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END XB
               ,CASE WHEN T2.KHH IS NULL THEN T1.DH  ELSE T2.JTDH END JTDH
               ,T1.DZ
               ,T4.ORG_NAME
               ,T2.MZDM NATION_ID
               ,T1.EMAIL
               ,cast(NVL(CAST(T4.BELONG_ID AS BIGINT),T4.ORG_ID) as BIGINT) BELONG_ID
          FROM crm.TKHXX T1
          LEFT JOIN trcif.cif_TGRKHXX T2 ON T1.KHH = T2.KHH
          JOIN crm.LKGCRM_L_ORGANIZATION T4 ON T1.YYB = T4.org_id

CASE

--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0

-- name test_v8trade
-- type Spark SQL
-- author wanghk@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2023-11-22 11:00:06
-- desc 

  insert overwrite table base_app_cisp.t_cisp_y8_busi partition(biz_month)
  SELECT
       ${bdp.system.premonth} fmonth,
       A.branch_code,
       A.LN1B,A.LN1E,
       nvl(A1.LN2B,0) ln2B,nvl(A1.LN2E,0) ln2E,
       A.LN1B-nvl(A1.LN2B,0) LN3B,A.LN1E-nvl(A1.LN2E,0) LN3E,
       A2.LN4B,A2.LN4E,
       B.LN5B,B.LN5E,
       nvl(C.LN7B,0)+nvl(D.LN8B,0) LN6B,nvl(C.LN7E,0)+nvl(D.LN8E,0) LN6E,
       C.LN7B,C.LN7E,
       NVL(D.LN8B,0) LN8B,NVL(D.LN8E,0) LN8E,
       I.LN9E,
       I.LN10E,
       I.LN11E,
       nvl(C.LN13E,0)+nvl(D.LN14E,0) AS LN12E,
       C.LN13E,
       nvl(D.LN14E,0) LN14E,
       A.LN22B+H.LN23B LN21B,A.LN22E+G.LN23E LN21E,
       A.LN22B,A.LN22E,
       H.LN23B,G.LN23E,
       h.fzje,g.fzje,   --  比例在查询时根据担保价值和负债金额进行计算获取
       CC.LN25B,CC.LN25E,
       h.LN21B,g.LN21E,
       ${bdp.system.premonth} as biz_month
 FROM (
-- /*期末信用资金账户数 */
SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
        SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1E,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1B,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  THEN
              T.zjye ELSE 0
           END) AS LN22B,   --  期初资金
       SUM(CASE
                 WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
                  T.ZJYE ELSE 0
               END) AS LN22E    --  期末资金
  FROM base_app_cisp.TB_RZRQ_TZJZHTJ T
 WHERE T.KHFLFS in(0, 1)
   AND T.RQ IN (${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}, ${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
   AND T.ZHLB = 2
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) A
   left join
   (
   select A.BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2E,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2B
        from (SELECT branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no as capital_account,
               min(cap_acct_state_code) as bal_status,
               min(open_date) as bal_opendate,
               min(CLOSE_date) as bal_closedate
          from base_data.tac_cap_acct 
          group by branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no) a
        join 
        (select a.cust_no, b.cap_acct_no as capital_account,a.branch_code
                From base_data.tpt_cust a
                join base_data.tac_cap_acct b on (b.ACCT_ATTR_CODE =2 and a.cust_no =b.cust_no)
                where a.cust_type_code = 1) b on (a.branch_code=b.branch_code and a.capital_account=b.capital_account)
      GROUP BY A.BRANCH_CODE
   )a1 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A1.BRANCH_CODE
   left join
   (
   select BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4E,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4B
        from base_app_cisp.tb_rzrq_tzqzhtj b
      where b.rq in(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})
      and b.khflfs in(1,0)
      GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   )a2 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A2.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5E,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5B  --  ,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
  left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE T.RQ IN ( ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) B ON A.BRANCH_CODE=B.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7E,   --  其中:融资余额 期末,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7B,   --  其中:融资余额 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzje               ELSE 0 END ) AS LN13E   --  其中:融资授信金额  期末
      FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczjtj T1
      left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t1.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE  T1.RQ <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) C ON A.BRANCH_CODE=C.BRANCH_CODE
left join
(
SELECT  t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25E,   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31')  and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25B   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_khlxtj T1 ,(select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=35 and entry_code ='9901') t2
 WHERE T1.yyb=t2.bran_entry_value and 
   T1.rq <= concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
   GROUP BY t2.entry_value
   ) CC ON A.BRANCH_CODE=CC.BRANCH_CODE
  LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8E,   --  其中:融券市值 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8B,   --  其中:融券市值 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq > ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN brrqje ELSE 0 END) AS LN14E   --  其中:融资授信金额
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczqtj T
 WHERE T.tx_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.tx_date>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
   and T.qsrq <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.qsrq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) D ON A.BRANCH_CODE=D.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zzc else 0 end ),0) AS LN21E,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23E,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.rq = CASE WHEN ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} =20200123 THEN 20200131 ELSE ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} END
   and t.rq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) G ON A.BRANCH_CODE=G.BRANCH_CODE
 LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then ZZC else 0 end),0) AS LN21B,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23B,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.tx_date =${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} and t.rq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY yyb
   ) H  ON A.BRANCH_CODE=H.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN
( SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
           COUNT(cust_no) AS LN9E, 
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '61' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN10E,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '64' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN11E
  FROM base_data.tev_sett_crdt T
 WHERE T.biz_date >${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  and  t.biz_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   AND TRIM(T.busi_subj) IN ('61', '64')
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
) I ON A.BRANCH_CODE=I.BRANCH_CODE
;

-- name 特殊机构及产品账户管理
-- type Spark SQL

-- create time 2024-11-28 15:26:07
-- desc 
--6-1-2
                SELECT
                T1.branch_code as `营业部代码`,
                T1.branch_name as `营业部名称`,
                T1.CUST_NO as `客户号`,
                T1.CUST_FULL_NAME as `本地客户全称`,
                T1.CERT_NO AS `本地证件号`,
                T2.KHMC AS `中登客户全称`,
                T2.ZJDM AS `中登证件号`,
                T2.YMTH as `一码通账户号`,
                case when t2.cplb='01' then '证券公司集合理财产品' 
                     when t2.cplb='02' then '证券公司专项资产管理计划'
                     when t2.cplb='03' then '基金公司特定客户资产管理产品'
                     when t2.cplb='04' then '基金公司特定客户资产管理产品（保险）'
                     when t2.cplb='05' then '基金公司特定客户资产管理产品（信托）'
                     when t2.cplb='06' then '封闭式证券投资基金'
                     when t2.cplb='07' then '开放式证券投资基金'
                     when t2.cplb='08' then '私募基金'
                     when t2.cplb='09' then '其他证券投资基金'
                     when t2.cplb='10' then '全国社保基金'
                     when t2.cplb='11' then '地方社保基金'
                     when t2.cplb='12' then '信托产品'
                     when t2.cplb='13' then '保险产品'
                     when t2.cplb='14' then '保险资产管理产品'
                     when t2.cplb='15' then '期货资产管理产品（多客户）'
                     when t2.cplb='16' then '期货资产管理产品（单一）'
                     when t2.cplb='17' then '企业(职业)年金计划'
                     when t2.cplb='18' then '合格境外投资者'
                     when t2.cplb='19' then '合格境外投资者（人民币）'
                     when t2.cplb='20' then '养老金产品'
                     when t2.cplb='21' then '银行理财产品'
                     when t2.cplb='22' then '上市公司员工持股计划'
                     when t2.cplb='23' then '证券公司单一资产管理计划'
                     when t2.cplb='24' then '基金管理公司单一资产管理计划'
                     when t2.cplb='25' then '基金管理公司集合资产管理计划'
                     when t2.cplb='26' then '基本养老保险金'
                     when t2.cplb='99' then '其他' end  as `产品类别`,
                     t2.CPDQR as `产品到期日`,
                        t2.GLRMC as `产品管理人名称`
                FROM
                (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        B.branch_code,C.branch_name,B.CUST_NO,trim(B.CUST_FULL_NAME) as CUST_FULL_NAME,trim(B.CERT_NO) as CERT_NO,
                        A.GDH AS ZQZH
                        
                    FROM
                        (
                            SELECT YYB,KHH,GDH,JYS,JSZH FROM MDA5.DATACENTER_TMR_GDH WHERE JYS IN ('SH', 'SZ', 'TA', 'BJ' )
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT YYB,KHH,GDH,JYS,JSZH FROM MDA5.DATACENTER_TSC_GDH WHERE JYS  IN ('SH', 'SZ', 'TA', 'BJ' )
                        ) A 
                    INNER JOIN
                        (SELECT * FROM BASE_DATA.TPT_CUST ) B ON A.KHH = B.CUST_NO  
                    LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.tpt_branch C ON B.BRANCH_CODE=C.BRANCH_CODE
                    GROUP BY B.branch_code,C.branch_name,B.CUST_NO,trim(B.CUST_FULL_NAME),trim(B.CERT_NO),A.GDH
                ) T1 
                INNER JOIN
                (
                    SELECT
                        A.YMTH,
                        A.ZQZH,
                        trim(B.KHMC) AS KHMC,
                        trim(B.ZJDM) AS ZJDM,
                        A.ZQZHZT,
                        A.ZHLB,
                        B.cplb,
                        B.CPDQR,
                        B.GLRMC
                    FROM
                        CSDC.QTZHZL A 
                    LEFT JOIN
                        CSDC.QTYMTZL B 
                            ON A.YMTH=B.YMTH      
                    WHERE   
                        A.ZQZHZT='00'    
                        AND B.khlb = '2'
		                and b.cpdqr<='20250930' and B.ymtzt = '0'
                ) T2 ON T1.ZQZH=T2.ZQZH
                GROUP BY T1.branch_code,
                T1.branch_name,
                T1.CUST_NO,
                T1.CUST_FULL_NAME,
                T1.CERT_NO,
                T2.KHMC,
                T2.ZJDM,
                T2.YMTH,
                T2.CPLB,
                t2.CPDQR,
                t2.GLRMC

COALESCE(M_40007.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.WTFS)) AS ENTR_MODE_CODE,
T.CZZD AS OPER_SITE,
regexp_replace(
case 
--1.1有mac字样开头，考虑存在中间分隔符或者不存在两张情况，末尾必须有分隔符或者字符尾
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',2)
--1.2无mac字样开头，考虑中间有分隔符号: (00:00:00:00:00:00  考虑：-|.和空格),并且前后有分隔符（标点、空格、开头和结尾）
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0)
--1.3无mac字样开头，考虑中间无分隔符号，排除UUID造成的影响
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
     and regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)<>
         regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',8)
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0)
else ''
end,
'[\\s\\pP\\W]','') as OPER_site_mac,
CASE
--2.1 IP判断有固定前缀的认为他准确
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE
--2.2 IP内网包含10网段 172,16-31,192.168
regexp_extract(
regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),--剔除10,127,172,192,255网段
'((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(([1-9]|1[1-9]|[2-9][0-9]|11[0-9]|12[012345689]|1[3-6][0-9]|17[013456789]|18[0-9]|19[013456789]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-4])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((172)[.]([1]?[0-5]|[3][2-9]|[4-9][0-9]|25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2})[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((192)[.]([1-9]?[0-9]|1[0-5][0-9]|16[012345679]|1[7-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))'
,0)
,'(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)',0)
end as OPER_site_ip,
case 
--3.1手机号优先判断有前缀的记录
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN:)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',7)
--3.2手机号只考虑有前后分隔符
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
END AS OPER_site_MOBILE,
case 
--4.1硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种 
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',6)
else ''
end as OPER_site_hd,
case 
--5.1 ios的uuid考虑有uuid开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_UUID,
case
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 or length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'

WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
when t.czzd rlike '^(172|10|192).\\d+.\\d+.\\d+$'
then '6'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%DZHG%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN 'DZHGB'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%SFJR%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN '3'
when (upper(t.czzd) like '%GSFY%' OR upper(t.czzd) like '%股市方圆%') AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA' 
THEN 'GSFY'
WHEN T.WTFS='8'-- OR upper(t.czzd) like '%127.0.0.1%'
THEN '4'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
else ''
END AS OPER_SOURCE,
COALESCE(M_40008.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.DDLB)) AS ENTR_TYPE_CODE,
T.JYLB AS BUSI_SUBJ,
FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP()) AS BIZ_TIME,
'MDA5' AS BIZ_SRC

LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_10002

  GROUP BY a.org_code
 ) b

  sum(CASE WHEN v.fyear=cast (cast(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4)-1 as int)as string) THEN v.ajj_bncjje ELSE 0 END) ajj_cjje_qn,
  sum(CASE WHEN v.fyear=cast (cast(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4)-1 as int)as string) THEN v.ajj_bnszl ELSE 0 END)*10 as qnfsje

          AND LPAD(v.fmonth,2,'0')=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth}, 5, 2)
          AND c.upbranch_code IS NOT NULL 
          GROUP BY   KH_DW_ID ) v
     ON a.KH_DW_ID=v.KH_DW_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT  d.KH_DW_ID,sum(khs_bn) khs_bn,COALESCE(sum(khs_qn),0) khs_qn
    FROM   (

-- name 反洗钱2025
-- type Spark SQL

-- create time 2026-01-13 13:47:32
-- desc 
---2025年反洗钱
--普通证券经纪业务客户资产规模
select sum(zzc-zqsz_flt-zqsz_jrcp) from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zc_r where rq=20251231;
--银证转账交易额
select sum(crje+qcje) from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_r where rq>=20250101 and rq<=20251231;
--证券非竞价交易额
select sum(cjje) from 
(select khh,jys,cjje,jylb,zqlb from mda5.datacenter_tsc_jgmxls where tx_date >= '20250101' and tx_date <= '20251231'
union all
select khh,jys,cjje,jylb,zqlb from mda5.datacenter_tmr_jgmxls where tx_date >= '20250101' and tx_date <= '20251231') t1 where (jys in ('TA') and jylb in ('78','79') and zqlb = 'AJ') or (jys in ('SZ','SH') and jylb in ('57','58','59','60')) or (jys = 'BJ' and jylb in ('78','79')) or (jylb in ('155','156','157','158','159','160','171','172','173','174'))
--客户多银行资金内转交易额
select sum(srje+fcje) from mda5.datacenter_tfc_zjmxls where tx_date>=20250101 and tx_date<=20251231  and ywkm in ('1003','1004');
--代销金融产品业务场外金额 seabox
select  sum(mtch_amt) from dws_wm.tev_cust_trd_mtch_finl_prod tctmfp where biz_date >='20250101' and biz_date <= '20251231' and finl_prod_type = '1' and is_otc = '1';
--非交易过户
select sum(cjje) cjje from mda5.datacenter_tsc_jgmxls where tx_date>=20250101 and tx_date<=20251231 and jylb in ('55','56','57','58','155','156','157','158','173','174','31','59','60','78','79','159','160','171','172')
--转托管业务金额
select sum(zrzqsz+zczqsz) from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_r where rq>=20250101 and rq<=20251231;
--融资融券金额
select sum(zfz) from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_r where rq=20251231;
--高净值个人客户资产规模和数量
select count(1),sum(zzc-zfz) from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_r x,trcif.cif_tgrkhxx y where rq=20251231 and x.khh=y.khh and x.zzc-x.zfz>=10000000;
--经纪业务活跃客户
select count(1) from (select khh,sum(cjje) cjje from mda5.datacenter_tsc_jgmxls where tx_date>=20250101 and tx_date<=20251231 and khh not in (select khh from trcif.cif_tjgkhxx where jglb in ('1','2','3')) group by khh having cjje >= '100000')
--特定非金融行业客户-第一类
select count(1) from  trcif.cif_tjgkhxx a,trcif.cif_tkhxx b 
where  a.khh=b.khh   and   b.khzt=0 and b.khrq<=20251231 and a.hydm not in (9)
and ( jgjyfw like '%黄金%' or  jgjyfw like '%钻石%' or jgjyfw like '%玉石%'  or  jgjyfw like '%玉%'  or  jgjyfw like '%个体%' or  jgjyfw like '%小微%' or  jgjyfw like '%房地产%' or  jgjyfw like '%房产%' );
--特定非金融行业客户-第二类gr('11')
select count(1) from  trcif.cif_tjgkhxx a,trcif.cif_tkhxx  b 
where  a.khh=b.khh   and   b.khzt=0 and b.khrq<=20251231 and a.hydm not in (9)
and (jgjyfw like '%会计%' or  jgjyfw like '%记账%' or  jgjyfw like '%财务%' or  jgjyfw like '%法律%' );
--非居民客户 ('6','4','15')
select count(1) from trcif.cif_tkhxx where zjlb in ('6','4','15');
--通过本机构非面对面渠道开立账户客户

select f.khh,b.cust_name,f.yyb,e.branch_name,e.addr,c.zzc_ggqq,a.done_amt,if(d.khh is null,2,cpbz) as cust_type,b.mobile_tel,f.zhdjrq,b.age,b.cert_no,i.zydm,j.hydm
from 
(select khh,yyb,min(zhdjrq) as zhdjrq from mda5.datacenter_tso_hyzh group by khh,yyb)f
left join (select cust_no,sum(done_amt) done_amt from base_data.tev_sett_opt where biz_date >='20230101' AND biz_date <='20231231'  group by cust_no) a on f.khh = a.cust_no
left join (select cust_no,cust_name,if(cust_type_name = '个人',2,0) as cust_type,mobile_tel,age,cert_no from base_app_cvm.cust_info_total) b on f.khh = b.cust_no 
left join (select khh,zzc_ggqq from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_r where rq='20231229')c on f.khh = c.khh 
left join (select khh,cpbz from trcif.cif_tjgkhxx)d on f.khh = d.khh
left join base_data.tpt_branch e on f.yyb = e.branch_code
left join (select khh,zydm from trcif.cif_tgrkhxx)g on f.khh = g.khh
left join (select khh,hydm from trcif.cif_tjgkhxx) h on f.khh = h.khh
left join (select ibm,note as zydm from trcif.cif_txtdm where fldm in ('GT_ZYDM'))i on g.zydm = i.ibm 
left join (select ibm,note as hydm from trcif.cif_txtdm where fldm in ('GT_HYDM'))j on  h.hydm = j.ibm

--- 20251118 客户控制属性不一致 导数据
--- 注意：以下代码只能在【hdp31--数据治理--控制权限_测试】运行，因为用到了注册函数conv2rgts
--- 注2：因为有特殊分隔符分号，任务只能在原生的sparksql3.2版本中运行，必须是建任务时就选择3.2版本才行
--- 注3：原始需求还要资金账户权限不一致的数据，a5和cif沟通后发现，cif中的trcif.cif_tzjzh中kzsx是老版本的，已经不用了。目前cif是直接调用柜台接口
-- 客户号去重 tra5.sectrade_tsc_khjykz
SELECT 
t1.khh,t3.kzsx as cif_kzsx,t2.khsx as a5_khsx,t2.skhsx  as a5_skhsx
from 
(select distinct nvl(cif.khh,a5.khh) as khh
FROM (SELECT khh,skzsx,CASE 
                WHEN skzsx = 1 THEN 1
                WHEN skzsx = 2 THEN 2
                WHEN skzsx = 3 THEN 4
                WHEN skzsx = 4 THEN 8
                WHEN skzsx = 5 THEN 16
                WHEN skzsx = 6 THEN 32
                WHEN skzsx = 7 THEN 64
                WHEN skzsx = 8 THEN 128
                WHEN skzsx = 9 THEN 256
                WHEN skzsx = 12 THEN 2048
                WHEN skzsx = 13 THEN 512
                WHEN skzsx = 14 THEN 1024
                WHEN skzsx = 15 THEN 4096
                WHEN skzsx = 16 THEN 8192
                WHEN skzsx = 17 THEN 16384
                WHEN skzsx = 18 THEN 32768
                WHEN skzsx = 19 THEN 65536
                END AS a5_kzsx,kzsx FROM (SELECT khh,kzsx FROM trcif.cif_tkhywsx WHERE kzsx IS NOT NULL) LATERAL VIEW explode(split(kzsx,';')) khywsx AS skzsx) cif
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT khh,skhsx,khsx FROM (SELECT khh,kzsx as khsx FROM tra5.sectrade_tsc_khjykz WHERE kzsx>0) LATERAL VIEW explode(split(conv2rgts(khsx,','),',')) khxx AS skhsx) a5
ON cif.khh=a5.khh AND cif.a5_kzsx=a5.skhsx
WHERE cif.khh IS NULL OR a5.khh IS NULL)t1
left join 
(SELECT khh,kzsx as khsx,concat_ws(',', sort_array(transform(split(conv2rgts(kzsx,','),','), x -> cast(log(x)/log(2) as int)+1))) skhsx FROM tra5.sectrade_tsc_khjykz WHERE kzsx>0)t2 on t1.khh=t2.khh
left join trcif.cif_tkhywsx t3 on t3.khh=t1.khh;


-- 客户控制属性不一致 普通交易股东号比较
select t1.khh,t1.jys,t1.gdh,t2.gdkzsx as cif_gdkzsx,t3.gdkzsx as a5_gdkzsx,t3.s_gdkzsx as a5_gdkzsx_trans from 
(SELECT DISTINCT nvl(cif.khh,a5.khh) as khh,nvl(cif.jys,a5.cif_jys) as jys,nvl(cif.gdh,a5.gdh) as gdh
FROM (SELECT khh,jys,gdh,cif_gdkzsx,gdkzsx,gdzt FROM (SELECT khh,jys,gdh,gdkzsx,gdzt FROM trcif.cif_tgdzh WHERE gdkzsx IS NOT NULL AND ywxt=1000) LATERAL VIEW explode(split(gdkzsx,';')) gdzh AS cif_gdkzsx) cif
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT khh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS cif_jys,gdh,sgdkzsx,CASE 
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 1 THEN 3
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 2 THEN 4
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 4 THEN 8
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 8 THEN 7
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 16 THEN 11
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 32 THEN 13
                END AS cif_gdkzsx,gdkzsx FROM (SELECT khh,jys,gdh,gdkzsx FROM tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh WHERE gdkzsx>0) LATERAL VIEW explode(split(conv2rgts(gdkzsx,','),',')) gdh AS sgdkzsx ) a5
ON cif.khh=a5.khh AND cif.jys=a5.cif_jys AND cif.gdh=a5.gdh AND cif.cif_gdkzsx=a5.cif_gdkzsx
WHERE cif.gdh IS NULL OR a5.gdh IS NULL)t1
left join 
(SELECT khh,jys,gdh,gdkzsx,gdzt FROM trcif.cif_tgdzh WHERE gdkzsx IS NOT NULL AND ywxt=1000)t2 
on t1.khh=t2.khh and t1.jys=t2.jys and t1.gdh=t2.gdh 
left join 
(select t.khh,t.cif_jys as jys,t.gdh,t.gdkzsx,concat_ws(',',collect_list(cif_gdkzsx)) s_gdkzsx from 
(SELECT khh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS cif_jys,gdh,sgdkzsx,CASE 
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 1 THEN 3
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 2 THEN 4
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 4 THEN 8
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 8 THEN 7
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 16 THEN 11
                                                        WHEN sgdkzsx = 32 THEN 13
                END AS cif_gdkzsx,gdkzsx FROM (SELECT khh,jys,gdh,gdkzsx FROM tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh WHERE gdkzsx>0) LATERAL VIEW explode(split(conv2rgts(gdkzsx,','),',')) gdh AS sgdkzsx )t
                group by t.khh,t.cif_jys,t.gdh,t.gdkzsx)t3 
                on t1.khh=t3.khh and t1.jys=t3.jys and t1.gdh=t3.gdh;

                     when t2.cplb='19' then '合格境外投资者（人民币）'
                     when t2.cplb='20' then '养老金产品'
                     when t2.cplb='21' then '银行理财产品'
                     when t2.cplb='22' then '上市公司员工持股计划'

                T1.CUST_FULL_NAME,

                T2.KHMC,
                T2.ZJDM,

,t3.total_asset,t3.ass_total_avg,t2.trade_exp
,t1.elig_lvl_name_stock,t1.stf_id, t1.stf_name

		LEFT JOIN base_mid.t_cust_trade_days_stats trd
		ON gd.khh = trd.cust_no
		) cif
LEFT OUTER JOIN (select khh,gdh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,1000 as ywxt from tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh 
      union all
      select khh,gdh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,1001 as ywxt from mda5.datacenter_tmr_gdh) a5
ON cif.khh = a5.khh and cif.gdh=a5.gdh and cif.jys=a5.gt_jys and cif.ywxt=a5.ywxt
WHERE a5.gdh is NULL;

		SELECT gd.khh,kh.khzt,gd.gdh,gd.jys,gd.gdzt,trd.exch_tx_times,gd.ywxt

		LEFT JOIN trcif.cif_tkhxx kh 
		ON gd.khh = kh.khh
		LEFT JOIN base_mid.t_cust_sec_acct_tx_stats_1y trd
		ON gd.gdh = trd.sec_acct_no
		) cif
LEFT OUTER JOIN (select khh,gdh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4

                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11

      union all
      select khh,gdh,jys,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8

                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,1001 as ywxt from mda5.datacenter_tmr_gdh) a5
ON cif.khh = a5.khh and cif.gdh=a5.gdh and cif.jys=a5.gt_jys and cif.ywxt=a5.ywxt
WHERE a5.gdh is NULL;

SELECT a5.khh,a5.khzt,a5.gdh,a5.gt_jys,a5.exch_tx_times,a5.ywxt,cif.khh,cif.gdh,cif.jys,cif.gdzt,cif.ywxt
FROM (SELECT ta5.khh,khxx.khzt,ta5.gdh,ta5.jys,ta5.gt_jys,ta5.gdzt,trd.exch_tx_times,ta5.ywxt
	  FROM (select khh,gdh,jys,gdzt,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,1000 as ywxt from tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh 
      union all
      select khh,gdh,jys,gdzt,CASE 
                            WHEN jys='SH' THEN 1
                            WHEN jys='SZ' THEN 2
                            WHEN jys='HB' THEN 3
                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,1001 as ywxt from mda5.datacenter_tmr_gdh) ta5
      LEFT JOIN tra5.manage_tmc_khxx khxx ON ta5.khh = khxx.khh
      LEFT JOIN base_mid.t_cust_sec_acct_tx_stats_1y trd ON ta5.gdh=trd.sec_acct_no
		) a5
LEFT OUTER JOIN  trcif.cif_tgdzh cif
ON cif.khh = a5.khh and cif.gdh=a5.gdh and cif.jys=a5.gt_jys and cif.ywxt=a5.ywxt
WHERE cif.gdh is NULL;

replace into
    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_BANK_MARG_BAL (
        -- 两融
        select
            a.biz_date,
            a.bank_code_en,
            a.marg_bal,
            ifnull(a.bank_bal,c.sjye) as bank_bal,
            ifnull(c.SJHFJE, ifnull(c.HKJE, c.ZJBD)) as settle_amt
        from
            (
                select
                    *
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_BANK_MARG_BAL
                where
                    biz_date = '${last_1_tx_date}'
            ) a
            inner join (
                select
                    *
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_CGZJBD_YH_RZRQ
                where
                    jyrq = '${last_1_tx_date}'
            ) c on a.bank_code_en = c.yhdm
            -- 三方
        union all
        select
            a.biz_date,
            a.bank_code_en,
            a.marg_bal,
            ifnull(a.bank_bal,d.sjye) as bank_bal,
            c.zjbd as settle_amt
        from
            (
                select
                    *
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_BANK_MARG_BAL
                where
                    biz_date = '${last_1_tx_date}'
            ) a
            inner join (
                select
                    t1.POST_CLEAR_DATE as jyrq,
                    t2.gt_ywdm as yhdm,
                    t1.zjbd - t1.RJSCBD as zjbd
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_CGYH_HKSP t1,
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_CGYH_MAP t2
                where
                    t1.POST_CLEAR_DATE = '${last_1_tx_date}'
                    and t1.acct_code = t2.yybz_ywdm
                    and t2.bank_type = 1
            ) c on a.bank_code_en = c.yhdm
             inner join (
                select
                    *
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_CGZJBD_YH
                where
                    jyrq = '${last_1_tx_date}'
            ) d on a.bank_code_en = d.khfl
        union all
        --期权
        select
            a.biz_date,
            a.bank_code_en,
            a.marg_bal,
            a.bank_bal,
            c.qsje as settle_amt
        from
            (
                select
                    *
                from
                    DWRPT_APP_FUNDSETT.T_BANK_MARG_BAL
                where
                    biz_date = '${last_1_tx_date}'
            ) a
            inner join (
                select
                    t1.jyrq,
                    t1.yhdm,
                    ifnull(t2.qsje, t1.qsje) as qsje
                from
                    (
                        select
                            tx_date as jyrq,
                            yhdm,
                            sum(ysje) qsje
                        from
                            dwreport.datacenter_tso_hyjytj
                        where
                            tx_date = '${last_1_tx_date}'
                        group by
                            yhdm
                    ) t1
                    left join (
                        SELECT
                            rq,
                            jsjg,
                            sum(zd_yhje - yh_zdje) as qsje
                        FROM
                            dwrpt_app_fundsett.T_GPQQ_JSHK
                        where
                            rq = '${last_1_tx_date}'
                        group by
                            jsjg
                    ) t2 on t1.yhdm = t2.jsjg
            ) c on a.bank_code_en = c.yhdm
    );

select j.rq,sum((nvl(b.dryk,0)+nvl(c.dryk,0)+nvl(d.dryk,0)+nvl(e.dryk,0))/(nvl(b.zxsz,0)+nvl(c.zxsz,0)+nvl(d.mcje,0)+nvl(e.mcje,0))) 
from base_app_ins.fund_temp a 
left join (
	select * from comm.jyr where rq BETWEEN '20230101' and '20231231'
) j on 1=1
left join (
	select zqdm,rq,sum(dryk) dryk,sum(zxsz) zxsz
	from adp_dm.ids_t_zqye_his
	where rq BETWEEN '20230101' and '20231231'
    group by zqdm,rq
) b on a.fund_code = b.zqdm and b.rq = j.rq
left join (
	select cpdm,rq,sum(dryk) dryk,sum(zxsz) zxsz
	from adp_dm.ids_t_fp_cpfe_his
	where rq BETWEEN '20230101' and '20231231'
    group by cpdm,rq
) c on a.fund_code = c.cpdm and c.rq = j.rq
left join (
	select zqdm,qcrq,sum(dryk) dryk,sum(mcje) mcje
	from adp_dm.ids_t_tzsy
	where qcrq BETWEEN '20230101' and '20231231'

) d on a.fund_code = d.zqdm  and d.qcrq = j.rq

	where qcrq BETWEEN '20230101' and '20231231'
    group by cpdm,qcrq
) e on a.fund_code = e.cpdm and e.qcrq = j.rq
group by j.rq

SELECT regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-','') as CL_MONTH -- V_CL_MONTH CL_MONTH,
                    , 0 as CURRENCY_CODE
                    , '人民币' as ENTRY_CONTENT
                    , ( CASE WHEN STOCK_TYPE='g' THEN '报价转让' ELSE '股份转让' END ) as STOCK_TYPE
                    , ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY_CODE='RMB' THEN A.M_MATCH_SUM ELSE A.M_MATCH_SUM * p.v_rate END),2) as M_MATCH_SUM 
                    , SUM(A.M_MATCH_QTY) as M_MATCH_QTY
                    , SUM(A.M_MATCH_CNT) as M_MATCH_CNT
                   -- , ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY_CODE='RMB' AND A.STOCK_TYPE ='g' THEN A.Y_MATCH_SUM ELSE 0 END),2) as Y_MATCH_SUM

                    , SUM(A.Y_MATCH_QTY) as Y_MATCH_QTY
                    , SUM(A.Y_MATCH_CNT) as Y_MATCH_CNT
            FROM (SELECT A.curr_code as CURRENCY_CODE -- 20230404变更  京A股份转让调整到报价转让
                          , ( CASE WHEN tx_market_code ='BJ' or sec_type_code in ('AA','AJ','AZ') THEN 'g'
                                ELSE sec_type_code END ) as STOCK_TYPE -- STOCK_TYPE = sec_type_code
                          , SUM(CASE WHEN biz_date BETWEEN concat(regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-',''),'01') 
                                                    AND regexp_replace(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')),-1)),'-','') THEN done_amt ELSE 0 END) as M_MATCH_SUM -- V_BEGIN_DATE,V_END_DATE,MATCH_SUM = done_amt
                          , SUM(CASE WHEN biz_date BETWEEN concat(regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-',''),'01') 
                                                    AND regexp_replace(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')),-1)),'-','') THEN  ABS(occur_qty) ELSE 0 END) as M_MATCH_QTY -- V_BEGIN_DATE,V_END_DATE
                          , SUM(CASE WHEN biz_date BETWEEN concat(regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-',''),'01') 
                                                    AND regexp_replace(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')),-1)),'-','') THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) as M_MATCH_CNT -- V_BEGIN_DATE,V_END_DATE
                          , SUM(done_amt ) as Y_MATCH_SUM -- MATCH_SUM = done_amt
                          , SUM(ABS(OCCUR_QTY)) as Y_MATCH_QTY
                          , COUNT(1) as Y_MATCH_CNT
                  FROM (select coalesce(case when a.tx_type_code = '97' then a.receable_share -- jylb = tx_type_code , yssl = receable_share
                                              when a.receable_share = 0 and a.tx_type_code <> '97' then a.done_qtty * case when a.receable_amt > 0 then -1 -- cjsl=done_qtty , ysje=receable_amt
                                                                                                                      else 1 end 
                                              else case when a.tx_type_code in ('21') then abs(a.receable_share) * -1
                                                        else a.receable_share end 
                                          end, 0 ) as occur_qty, a.* 
                          from base_data.tev_sett a ) A -- HISTORY.TB_STK_CAP_CHG A
                  WHERE A.biz_date BETWEEN concat(substr(regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-',''),1,4),'0101') -- V_BEGIN_YEAR 
                                    AND regexp_replace(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')),-1)),'-','') -- V_END_DATE  --20150505 根据业务需要，只统计当月数据
                    AND A.comm_amt > 0 -- COMMISSION=comm_amt
                    AND tx_market_code IN ('BJ','6','TA','TU','g')   -- BJ=5-北京A股   6-淄博基金   TA=9-特别转让    TU=A-沪B转让   G-浙江基金 
                    -- (select * from base_cfg.tmg_dict_entry_map where dict_entry='TX_MARKET_CODE' and prev_dict_entry = 'GT_JYS' )
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN tx_market_code ='BJ' or sec_type_code in ('AA','AJ','AZ') THEN 'g' ELSE sec_type_code END , curr_code   
                ) A
            join (select * from base_cfg.tmg_dict_entry_map where dict_entry='CURR_CODE' and prev_sys='MDA5' ) B -- PARAMS.TB_DICT_ENTRY B
              on A.CURRENCY_CODE = B.prev_dict_entry_key -- A.CURRENCY_CODE=B.ENTRY_VALUE AND ENTRY_CODE=1304  
            join (
  SELECT t.curr_midrate as v_rate -- T.EXCHANGE_RATE / 100 INTO V_RATE
  FROM base_data.tpd_rmb_midrate t -- dwreport.EXCHANGE_RATE T
  join (select m.rq as rq from (
  select rq,row_number() over (order by rq desc) as row_num from comm.jyr where jyrbs = 3
  and substr(rq,1,6) = regexp_replace(substr(add_months(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('20260302','yyyyMMdd')) as date),-1),1,7),'-','')
  ) m where m.row_num = 1 ) r 
  on r.rq = t.biz_date
 WHERE t.curr_code = 'USD' ) p
      GROUP BY CASE WHEN A.STOCK_TYPE='g' THEN '报价转让' ELSE '股份转让' END

--(

--oper_site_mobile,
--oper_site_hd,

--oper_site_imei,

--oper_chnl_code
--)
SELECT
T.ID AS SEQU_NO,
T.RQ AS TX_DATE,
T.FSSJ AS OCCU_TIME,
T.KHH AS CUST_NO,
T.KHJC AS CUST_NAME,
T.ZJZH AS CAP_ACCT_NO,
T.YWKM AS BUSI_SUBJ,
T.ZY AS SUMMY,
T.CZGY AS OPER_TELLER,
COALESCE(M_10002.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT(T2.orgcode)) AS BRANCH_CODE,
T2.orgcode AS SRC_BRANCH_CODE,
COALESCE(M_10002_2.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT(T3.orgcode)) AS OPER_BRANCH_CODE,
T.CZZD AS OPER_SITE,
regexp_replace(
case 
--1.1有mac字样开头，考虑存在中间分隔符或者不存在两张情况，末尾必须有分隔符或者字符尾
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',2)
--1.2无mac字样开头，考虑中间有分隔符号: (00:00:00:00:00:00  考虑：-|.和空格),并且前后有分隔符（标点、空格、开头和结尾）
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0)
--1.3无mac字样开头，考虑中间无分隔符号，排除UUID造成的影响
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
     and regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)<>
         regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',8)
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0)
else ''
end,
'[\\s\\pP\\W]','') as OPER_site_mac,
CASE
--2.1 IP判断有固定前缀的认为他准确
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE
--2.2 IP内网包含10网段 172,16-31,192.168
regexp_extract(
regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),--剔除10,127,172,192,255网段
'((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(([1-9]|1[1-9]|[2-9][0-9]|11[0-9]|12[012345689]|1[3-6][0-9]|17[013456789]|18[0-9]|19[013456789]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-4])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((172)[.]([1]?[0-5]|[3][2-9]|[4-9][0-9]|25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2})[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((192)[.]([1-9]?[0-9]|1[0-5][0-9]|16[012345679]|1[7-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))'
,0)
,'(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)',0)
end as OPER_site_ip,
case 
--3.1手机号优先判断有前缀的记录
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN:)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',7)
--3.2手机号只考虑有前后分隔符
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
END AS OPER_site_MOBILE,
case 
--4.1硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种[;,]
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',6)
else ''
end as OPER_site_hd,
case 
--5.1 ios的uuid考虑有uuid开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_UUID,
case
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 or length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'
else ''
END AS OPER_SOURCE,
COALESCE(M_40014.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.FQQD)) AS OPER_CHNL_CODE,
FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP()) AS BIZ_TIME,
'TRCIF' AS BIZ_SRC
FROM TRCIF.CIF_TCZMX T
left JOIN TRCIF.CIF_LBORGANIZATION T2
ON T.YYB=T2.ID
AND T.TX_DATE=T2.TX_DATE
left JOIN TRCIF.CIF_LBORGANIZATION T3
ON T.FSYYB=T3.ID
AND T.TX_DATE=T3.TX_DATE 
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_10002
ON T2.orgcode = M_10002.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_10002.DICT_ENTRY = '10002'
AND M_10002.PREV_SYS = 'TRCIF'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_10002_2
ON T3.orgcode = M_10002_2.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_10002_2.DICT_ENTRY = '10002'
AND M_10002_2.PREV_SYS = 'TRCIF'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40014
ON  T.FQQD = M_40014.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40014.DICT_ENTRY = '40014'
AND M_40014.PREV_SYS = 'TRCIF'
WHERE T.TX_DATE='${bdp.system.bizdate}'

THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'((MPN:)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',7)
--3.2手机号只考虑有前后分隔符
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''
END AS OPER_SITE_MOBILE,

--截取错误 将HD 后面所有字段全部截取了
CASE 
--4.1硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种[;,]
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9A-ZA-Z-_\\S.]+)(([;,])|($))''',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9A-ZA-Z-_\\S.]+)(([;,])|($))''',6)
ELSE ''
END AS OPER_SITE_HD,
--edit by fwy
--参照上述逻辑 
--硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种  将字段分割为map
-- CASE
-- WHEN LENGTH(STR_TO_MAP(T.CZZD,';','=')['HD'])<>0
-- THEN STR_TO_MAP(T.CZZD,';','=')['HD']
-- ELSE ''
-- END AS OPER_SITE_HD,

CASE 
--5.1 IOS的UUID考虑有UUID开头
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(UUID)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(UUID)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''
END AS OPER_SITE_UUID,
CASE
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(IMEI)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(IMEI)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''
END AS OPER_SITE_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 OR LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'

WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
WHEN T.CZZD RLIKE '^(172|10|192).\\D+.\\D+.\\D+$'
THEN '6'
WHEN UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%DZHG%' AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN 'DZHGB'
WHEN UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%SFJR%' AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN '3'
WHEN (UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%GSFY%' OR UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%股市方圆%') AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA' 
THEN 'GSFY'
WHEN T.WTFS='8' --OR UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%127.0.0.1%'
THEN '4'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TYPE[\\S\\PP\\W])([0-9A-ZA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TYPE[\\S\\PP\\W])([0-9A-ZA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
ELSE ''

with temp as (select trim(w.bran_entry_value) as bran_entry_value,

                  from rmc.dict_entry_map w 
		              where w.entry_code = '1301' 
			              and w.bran_entry_code = '1301'
                    and w.version_id = '35' )
 select a.branch_code as branch_code,
        a.capital_account as capital_account, 
        --decode(trim(i.full_name),null,i.client_name,i.full_name) as client_name,
        (case when trim(i.cust_full_name) is null then i.cust_name --i.full_name--i.client_name
              else i.cust_full_name  --i.full_name
        end) as client_name,
        a.contract_no as current_contract_no,
        a.market_code as market_code,  -- coalesce(n.entry_value,concat('?',a.market_code)) as market_code,
        a.stockholder as stockholder,
        a.stock_code as stock_code,
        a.stock_name as stock_name,
        (b.qty - b.qty_gz) as match_qty,  ---股票数量(证券-国债) 
        (b.sz - b.sz_gz) as market_value, ---股票市值(证券-国债) 
        b.BJ as match_sum,
        (case when (b.BJ - (b.QSJE - b.YZLX-B.WYJ) - b.bjcd_sum + (g.ljlx  - g.jxje)) = 0 then 999999
              else least((b.sz + b.hl_sz + b.hl_sh + b.bzj + b.bzj2 + b.zyje) / (b.BJ - (b.QSJE - b.YZLX-B.WYJ) - b.bjcd_sum + (g.ljlx  - g.jxje)),999999)
        end) as gurantee_rate,
        '' as riskrank_code,
        (case when (b.BJ - (b.QSJE - b.YZLX-B.WYJ) - b.bjcd_sum + (g.ljlx  - g.jxje)) = 0 then 999999
                    else least( (b.sz + b.hl_sz + b.hl_sh + b.bzj + b.bzj2 + b.zyje) / (b.BJ - (b.QSJE - b.YZLX-B.WYJ) - b.bjcd_sum +
                      (g.ljlx  - g.jxje)),999999)
                  end) as merge_rate,
        (case when (d.sec_type_code = '0' or d.sec_type_code = '+') --stock_type
                then '0'
              when (d.sec_type_code = 'V' or d.sec_type_code = 'v' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = '1' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = '6' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = 'O') 
                then '1'
              when (d.sec_type_code = 'X' or d.sec_type_code = 'Y' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = 'U' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = '9' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = 'm' 
                                          or d.sec_type_code = 'M') 
                then '2'
        end) as zqlx, 
        a.cpdm as cpdm,
        a.cplb as cplx,
        a.match_date as match_date,
        a.pcbl as botton_rate,  ---平仓线
        a.yjbl as top_rate,     ---预警线
        '' as warn_rate,--f.warn_rate
        '' as remark1,--f.
        '' as remark2,--f.
        '' as remark3,--f.
        a.end_date as end_date,
        (b.hl_sz + b.hl_sh) as bonus_total,
        b.bzj as deposit,
        b.sz_gz as market_value_gz,
        b.qty_gz as match_qty_gz,
        b.bzj2 as deposit2,
        (nvl(c.lx_lj,0) + b.dzlx) as yflx,
        ((b.QSJE - b.YZLX-b.wyj) + b.bjcd_sum) as yhje,
        (b.BJ - (b.QSJE - b.YZLX-b.wyj) - b.bjcd_sum) as dghje,
        g.ljlx as ljlx,
        g.jxje as yhlx,
        (g.ljlx - g.jxje) as dhlx,
        B.LL as ll,
        b.zyje as zyje,
        b.qsje as clear_sum,
        '' as wyht,
        B.WYJ as wyj,
        (case when trim(k.jyzt) ='9'  --20240827 退市标记逻辑优化
                or( j.s_type_st is not null 
                and j.s_type_st != '')
                then '1' 
              else '0' 
        end) as tsbz,
        NVL(GZLB,0) as gzlb,
        (case when a.contract_no='51979' then 1 else 0 end) as IS_CISP, -- a.contract_no as current_contract_no,
        b.biz_date as biz_date  --sjrq
      from (select t.*
              from rmc.dw_tb_zyhg_contract t --history.Tb_Zyhg_Contract A
             where t.biz_date = '20250331' --tradedate--i_data_begin_date
             ) a 
      left join rmc.dw_tb_zyhg_mx b  --venture.tb_zyhg_mx b 
             on b.biz_date = '20250331' --sjrq--i_data_begin_date
            and a.capital_account = b.capital_account
            and a.contract_no = cast(b.contract_no as string) --to_char(b.contract_no)  
      left join (select a.capital_account as  capital_account, ---计算累计利息
                        a.contract_no as contract_no,
                        sum(a.lx) as lx_lj
                   from rmc.dw_tb_zyhg_lx_mx a, --venture.tb_zyhg_lx_mx a, 
                        rmc.dw_tb_zyhg_mx b --venture.tb_zyhg_mx b
                  where b.biz_date = '20250331' --sjrq--i_data_begin_date
                    and a.biz_date between REGEXP_REPLACE(date_add(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(b.jxrq, 'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd'),1),'-','')  --sjrq--get_last_nature_date(jxrq)
                                   and '20250331'  --i_data_begin_date
                    and a.capital_account = b.capital_account
                    and a.contract_no = b.contract_no
                  group by a.capital_account, a.contract_no) c 
             on a.capital_account = c.capital_account
            and a.contract_no = c.contract_no   
      left join (select coalesce(n.entry_value,'?') as tx_market_code,  -- x.tx_market_code as tx_market_code,
            		        x.sec_code as sec_code,
            			      y.dict_entry_key as sec_type_code
                   from base_data.tpd_sec_code x
                   join rmc.tmg_dict_entry_map y
                     on x.sec_type_code = y.prev_dict_entry_key
                   join temp n 
                     on x.tx_market_code = trim(n.bran_entry_value) ) d  --params.tb_stkcode d 
             on a.market_code = d.tx_market_code  --market_code
            and a.stock_code = d.sec_code  --stock_code
                      ----     盘后  结息金额取当天;累计利息取上一交易日+利息  20190923
      left join (select t.seqno as seqno, 
                        t.jxje as jxje,  
                        --(T.JDJXJE+T.YJLX +T.fdjxje+T.FXLX-T.DGHTZ-T.BRXZLX) as ljlx
                        (T.JDJXJE+T.YJLX +T.fdjxje+T.FXLX-T.DGHTZ) as ljlx--20231012 ljlx与柜台保持一致，不再扣减本日新增利息
                   from rmc.dw_tb_zyhg_contract t  --history.tb_zyhg_contract t
                  where t.biz_date = '20250331' --tradedate--i_data_begin_date
                    and t.over_date = '0'
                    and t.match_no >= '0'
                    and t.match_date <> 0
                    and t.match_sum > 0
                    and t.entrust_type = '53'
                    and t.contract_no not in (7093, 39697)) g on a.seqno = g.seqno
      left join base_data.tpt_cust i  --closing.tb_capital_account i 
             on a.capital_account=i.cust_no
            and a.branch_code=i.branch_code
      left join (select substr(j.s_info_windcode, 0, 6) as s_info_windcode,
      					(case when substr(j.s_info_windcode, 8, 2) = 'SH' then '1'  --1
                              when substr(j.s_info_windcode, 8, 2) = 'SZ' then '2'  --2
                        end) as s_info_market,
                        MAX(j.entry_dt) as entry_dt,
                        j.s_type_st
                   from wind.wind_asharest j --wdzx.asharest j
                  where '20250331' --I_DATA_BEGIN_DATE 
                  between j.entry_dt and nvl(trim(j.remove_dt), '99991231')
                    and j.s_type_st = 'T'
                  GROUP BY s_info_windcode, s_type_st) j 
             on a.stock_code = j.s_info_windcode
            and a.market_code = j.s_info_market
      left join (select k.biz_date,k.stock_code,coalesce(n.entry_value,'?') as market_code,k.jyzt
               from rmc.dw_tb_stkcode k
            left join (select trim(w.bran_entry_value) as bran_entry_value,
 			                        trim(w.entry_value) as entry_value
                        from rmc.dict_entry_map w 
		                   where w.entry_code = '1301' 
			                   and w.bran_entry_code = '1301'
                         and w.version_id = '35' ) n
              on k.market_code = trim(n.bran_entry_value)
            ) k  --history.tb_stkcode k 
             on a.biz_date = k.biz_date  --tradedate
            and a.stock_code = k.stock_code
            and a.market_code = k.market_code
      left join (select Q.CONTRACT_NO as CONTRACT_NO,
                        Q.GZLB as GZLB
                   from (select row_number() over(partition by q.contract_no order by q.tradedate_begin desc) as hc,
                                q.* 
                           from rmc.dw_zyhg_wyj q --params.tb_zyhg_wyj q
                         where q.sjzt='1' ) q
                  where q.hc=1) q
             on a.CONTRACT_NO=q.contract_no
     where a.over_date = '0'
       and a.match_no >= '0' 
       and a.match_date <> 0
       and a.match_sum > 0
       and a.entrust_type = '53'
       and a.contract_no not in ('7093', '39697') --去掉违约但未加结算日期的
       and b.biz_date = '20250331' --sjrq--i_data_begin_date
       ORDER BY a.CONTRACT_NO;

--对应LCDCHIS.T_DPZDF_MM 大盘涨跌幅月表
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE crm.t_dpzdf_mm
select '399300' zsdm
,nvl(round((qm - qc )/qc,4),0) as dpzdf 
,${bdp.system.premonth} t_month
from (
	select 
	 (SELECT ZXJ FROM adp_cfg.INFO_THIS_ZSHQ 
	  WHERE ZSDM = '399300' 
	  AND RQ = ( SELECT max(rq) FROM comm.jyr WHERE SUBSTR(RQ,0,6) = ${bdp.system.premonth} AND jyrbs  = 3)	
	 ) as qm --期末(月份的最后一个交易日)，比如说202509，这里就是rq=20250930
	,(SELECT ZXJ FROM adp_cfg.INFO_THIS_ZSHQ 
	  WHERE ZSDM = '399300' 
	  AND RQ = ( SELECT max(rq) FROM comm.jyr WHERE SUBSTR(RQ,0,6) = date_format(add_months(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp('${bdp.system.premonth}','yyyyMM')),-1) ,'yyyyMM') AND jyrbs  = 3)
	  ) as qc --期初(月份的上月的最后一个交易日)，比如说202509，这里就是rq=20250829
) a
;
-- END
