-- name p990000199_v2
-- type Spark SQL
-- author admin@dtstack.com
-- create time 2023-12-25 13:13:57
-- desc 目标表:base_app_glkj.tszl_2  迁移报表，财务报表市占率计算


--清理数据，防止重复计算 hive不支持delete,改用insert OVERWRITE方法
--delete from base_app_glkj.tszl_2
--where fyear=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},1,4) and fmonth=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},5,2);
--执行计算本月各个营业部市占率及本年累计市占率
--SET spark.sql.crossjoin.enabled=true ; 
alter table base_app_glkj.tszl_2 drop if EXISTS partition(fyear=2025,fmonth=9) ;

insert OVERWRITE table base_app_glkj.tszl_2 partition(fyear,fmonth)
SELECT AA.UNIT_CODE,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS AJJ_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_LJCJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_LJCJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_BNSZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_LJCJJE / 2.0) *100.0/ (BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE*1.0)) END,8) AS AJJ_BNSZL,
       AA.A_CJJE,--本期A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_CJJE,--本期A股+基金成交金额
       AA.A_LJCJJE as A_BNCJJE,--本年累计A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_LJCJJE as AJJ_BNCJJE--本年累计A股+基金成交金额
       ,BB.SC_A_CJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE,
       BB.SC_A_LJCJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE,
       ${bdp.system.bizdate} AS TX_DATE,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4) as fyear,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},5,2) as fmonth
  FROM (select T.UNIT_CODE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE) A_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE + T.JJ_CJJE) AJJ_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE) A_LJCJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE + T.JJ_LJCJJE) AJJ_LJCJJE
          from (
                --经纪
                SELECT b.map_branch_code AS UNIT_CODE,
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM base_sum.tmul_day_rport A
                  --20240409修改by-zj:一些取消的网络营业部被代管，需要关联营业部代管映射表
                  left join rmdc.GLKJ_FZJG_BRANCH_MAP B on a.yyb=b.branch_code
                 WHERE  a.rq>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 GROUP BY b.map_branch_code
                --信用
                union all
                SELECT b.map_branch_code AS UNIT_CODE,
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0','A6','C0','AC','AD','CD','AK','CR','NA','NC','RA','RC','RK','NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0', 'A6', 'C0', 'AC', 'AD', 'CD', 'AK', 'AN', 'RK', 'RN', 'CR', 'NA', 'NC', 'RA', 'RC', 'NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
             ----202101修改 'EA','EB','EC'
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM rmc.DW_TB_RZRQ_TZQJYTJ A
                   --20240409修改by-zj:一些取消的网络营业部被代管，需要关联营业部代管映射表
                  left join rmdc.GLKJ_FZJG_BRANCH_MAP B on a.yyb=b.branch_code
                 where A.khflfs IN (0,1)  --202101修改
                 AND a.biz_date>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 AND A.MARKET_CODE IN ('SH','SZ')--20240207修改
                 GROUP BY b.map_branch_code) T
         GROUP BY T.UNIT_CODE) AA CROSS JOIN
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN --20221128 增加BJ市场
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_CJJE, --市场本期Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) * 10000
                       END ELSE 0 END),
                   0) SC_AJJ_CJJE, --市场本期A+基金成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                              SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_LJCJJE, --市场本年Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case

-- name D1_交易周期表
-- type Spark SQL
-- author yangyingzi@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2026-06-08 16:48:48
-- desc 
--aml means anti-money laundering

-- CREATE table if not EXISTS base_app_tag.dim_aml_trade_5d_period(
--     period_id                        int,
--     period_start_date                STRING,   
--     period_end_date                  STRING,
--     sample_date                      STRING,
--     is_complete                      INT,
--     update_time                      STRING
-- ) comment '反洗钱用户画像五交易日周期维表'
-- stored as parquet;

with start_day as (
	select min(rq) as start_trade_date
	from comm.jyr
	where jyrbs=3
			and rq>='20230101' and rq<'20240101'
),

trade_days as (
	select c.rq,
			ROW_NUMBER () over (order by c.rq) as rn
	from comm.jyr c
	join start_day s on c.rq>=s.start_trade_date
	where c.jyrbs=3
),

period_base as (
	select rq, floor((rn-1)/5)+1 as period_id
	from trade_days
)

INSERT OVERWRITE table base_app_tag.dim_aml_trade_5d_period
select period_id,
		min(rq) as period_start_date,
		max(rq) as period_end_date,
		max(rq) as sample_date,
		case when count(*)=5 then 1 else 0 end as is_complete,
		${bdp.system.currmonth} as update_time
from period_base
group by period_id
having count(*)=5

                            WHEN jys='SB' THEN 4
                            WHEN jys='TA' THEN 5
                            WHEN jys='TU' THEN 6
                            WHEN jys='HK' THEN 7
                            WHEN jys='SK' THEN 8
                            WHEN jys='BJ' THEN 9
                            WHEN jys='HY' THEN 10
                            WHEN jys='SY' THEN 11
                            END AS gt_jys,zzhbz,gdzt,1001 as ywxt from mda5.datacenter_tmr_gdh) a5
WHERE cif.khh = a5.khh AND cif.gdh = a5.gdh AND cif.zzhbz != a5.zzhbz AND cif.jys = a5.gt_jys AND cif.ywxt = a5.ywxt AND cif.gdzt != 6
AND cif.khh not in (select khh from (select khh,jys,zzhbz,ywxt from trcif.cif_tgdzh group by khh,jys,zzhbz,ywxt having count(*)>1) t1)
AND a5.khh not in (select khh from (select khh,jys,zzhbz from tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh group by khh,jys,zzhbz having count(*)>1) t2)
AND cif.gdh not in (select gdh from (select gdh,jys,zzhbz,ywxt from trcif.cif_tgdzh group by gdh,jys,zzhbz,ywxt having count(*)>1) t1)
AND a5.gdh not in (select gdh from (select gdh,jys,zzhbz from tra5.sectrade_tsc_gdh group by gdh,jys,zzhbz having count(*)>1) t2);

SELECT distinct zzhbz FROM trcif.cif_tgdzh limit 100;

-- =======================================================================
-- 柜台资金账号问题核检
-- 4.柜台资金账号：gtzjzh
-- CIF和A5同一客户的柜台资金账号一致
select cif.khh,cif.zhzt,cif.zhlb,cif.gtzjzh,cif.bz,cif.sybz,cif.zgtzjzh,a5.khh,a5.zhzt,a5.zhlb,a5.zjzh,a5.zzhbz from trcif.cif_tgtzjzh cif,(select * from tra5.fund_tfc_zjzh where tx_date ='20250122') a5
where cif.khh = a5.khh and cif.zhzt = a5.zhzt and cif.zhlb = a5.zhlb and cif.gtzjzh != a5.zjzh;

SELECT DISTINCT cif.khh,cif.gtzjzh,cif.zhzt,a5.khh,a5.zjzh,a5.zhzt 
FROM trcif.cif_tgtzjzh cif FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tra5.fund_tfc_zjzh WHERE tx_date = '20250312') a5 ON cif.khh = a5.khh AND cif.gtzjzh = a5.zjzh
WHERE cif.gtzjzh is null OR a5.zjzh is null;
-- CIF这边没有同步zzhbz，同时zhlb信息不正确，同时CIF信息是从A5同步，是否校验后续群里讨论

-- 增加客户状态信息
SELECT cif.khh,cif.gtzjzh,cif.zhzt,cif.khzt,a5.khh,a5.zjzh,a5.zhzt,a5.khzt FROM 
	(SELECT gt.*,xx.khzt FROM trcif.cif_tgtzjzh gt
	 LEFT JOIN trcif.cif_tkhxx xx ON gt.khh = xx.khh) cif
FULL OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT ta5.*,a5xx.khzt FROM (SELECT * FROM tra5.fund_tfc_zjzh WHERE tx_date = '20250403') ta5
	 LEFT JOIN tra5.manage_tmc_khxx a5xx ON ta5.khh = a5xx.khh) a5
ON cif.khh = a5.khh AND cif.gtzjzh = a5.zjzh
WHERE cif.gtzjzh is null OR a5.zjzh is null;

-- =======================================================================
-- 风险承受能力等级问题核检
-- 5.风险承受能力等级：sdx
-- CIF和A5同一客户的风险承受能力等级一致
-- 与A5对应的是JJFXCSNL
select cif.khh,cif.sdxlb,cif.cpdj,a5.khh,a5.fxcsnl from trcif.cif_tkhsdx cif,tra5.manage_tmc_khsdxsx a5 
where cif.khh = a5.khh and cif.sdxlb='JJFXCSNL' and cif.cpdj != a5.fxcsnl;  

-- 增加测评日期和客户状态
SELECT FX.*,SDX.khh,SDX.sdxlb,SDX.cprq,SDX.cpdj
FROM (SELECT cif.khh,kh.khzt,cif.sdxlb,cif.cprq,cif.cpdj,a5.khh,a5.pcrq,a5.fxcsnl
			   FROM trcif.cif_tkhsdx cif,tra5.manage_tmc_khsdxsx a5,trcif.cif_tkhxx kh
			   WHERE cif.khh = a5.khh AND cif.khh = kh.khh AND cif.sdxlb='JJFXCSNL' and cif.cpdj != a5.fxcsnl) FX
LEFT JOIN trcif.cif_tkhsdx SDX 
ON FX.khh = SDX.khh AND FX.cpdj = 0 AND SDX.sdxlb='GPFXCSNL';

-- name t_cisp_y8_trade
-- type Spark SQL
-- author wanghk@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2023-11-17 08:56:08
-- desc 

insert overwrite table base_app_cisp.t_cisp_y8_trade partition(biz_month)
select fmonth,branch_code,data_type,data_sn,stock_code,stock_name,exchange_name,match_qty,market_value,fmonth biz_month
  from (
  --  融资融券  买入
SELECT ${bdp.system.premonth} fmonth, 
        BRANCH_CODE,1 data_type,
        ROW_NUMBER()OVER(partition by branch_code ORDER BY SUM(done_amt) DESC ) AS data_sn,
       T.sec_code as stock_code,  --   证券代码
       MIN(T.sec_name) STOCK_NAME,  --  证券名称
       CASE WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SH' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SZ' THEN '深圳证券交易所'  WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'BJ' THEN '北京证券交易所'  END AS exchange_name,
       SUM(done_qtty) match_qty,  --  成交证券数量
       SUM(done_amt) market_value  --  成交证券市值        ZXSZ,  --  证券市值   A5后逻辑变化
  FROM base_data.tev_sett_crdt T
 WHERE T.biz_date BETWEEN concat(${bdp.system.premonth},'01') AND concat(${bdp.system.premonth},'31')
   AND T.busi_subj = '61'
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE,CASE WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SH' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SZ' THEN '深圳证券交易所'  WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'BJ' THEN '北京证券交易所' END, T.sec_code
union all
  --  卖出
 SELECT ${bdp.system.premonth} fmonth, BRANCH_CODE,2 data_type,
        ROW_NUMBER()OVER(partition by branch_code ORDER BY SUM(done_amt) DESC ) AS data_sn,
       T.sec_code as stock_code,  --   证券代码
       MIN(T.sec_name) STOCK_NAME,  --  证券名称
       CASE WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SH' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SZ' THEN '深圳证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'BJ' THEN '北京证券交易所'  END AS exchange_name,
       SUM(done_qtty) match_qty,  --  成交证券数量
       SUM(done_amt) market_value  --  成交证券市值        ZXSZ,  --  证券市值   A5后逻辑变化
  FROM base_data.tev_sett_crdt T
 WHERE T.biz_date BETWEEN concat(${bdp.system.premonth},'01') AND concat(${bdp.system.premonth},'31')
   AND T.busi_subj = '64'
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE,CASE WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SH' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'SZ' THEN '深圳证券交易所' WHEN T.tx_market_code = 'BJ' THEN '北京证券交易所'  END, T.sec_code
          ) a

then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_UUID,
case
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 or length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'
WHEN T.WTFS='8'
THEN '4'
WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
else ''
END AS OPER_SOURCE,
COALESCE(M_20005.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.BZ)) AS CURR_CODE,
T.ZY AS SUMMY,
COALESCE(M_40026.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.DDZT)) AS OTC_ORDER_STATE_CODE,
COALESCE(M_40027.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.CLBZ)) AS DEAL_FLAG,
T.QRRQ AS CONFIRM_DATE,
T.SFSD AS IS_ELIG,
T.BSDSM AS ELIG_SUMMY,
T.KHJL AS CUST_MNGR,
T.CJJE AS DONE_AMT,
T.CJSL AS DONE_QTTY,
COALESCE(M_40028.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.FXCSNL)) AS CUST_RISK_RATING_CODE,
COALESCE(M_40029.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.CPFXPJ)) AS PROD_RISK_RATING_CODE,
FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP()) AS BIZ_TIME,
'TROTC' AS BIZ_SRC,
coalesce(m_50022.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t2.cpfl)) as Prod_Type_Code
FROM trotc.fpss_tfp_drwtls_dqs T
left join TROTC.FPSS_TFP_CPDM t2   on t.cpdm=t2.cpdm  
                                  and t.tx_date=t2.tx_date
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_10002
ON lpad(T.YYB,4,'0') = M_10002.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_10002.DICT_ENTRY = '10002'
AND M_10002.PREV_SYS = 'TRCIF'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_10002_2
ON lpad(T.fsYYB,4,'0') = M_10002_2.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_10002_2.DICT_ENTRY = '10002'
AND M_10002_2.PREV_SYS = 'TRCIF'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40025
ON T.JSFS = M_40025.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40025.DICT_ENTRY = '40025'
AND M_40025.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40015
ON T.SFFS = M_40015.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40015.DICT_ENTRY = '40015'
AND M_40015.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40022
ON T.JESHCLFS = M_40022.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40022.DICT_ENTRY = '40022'
AND M_40022.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40016
ON T.FHFS = M_40016.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40016.DICT_ENTRY = '40016'
AND M_40016.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40021
ON T.DJYY = M_40021.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40021.DICT_ENTRY = '40021'
AND M_40021.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40007
ON T.WTFS = M_40007.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40007.DICT_ENTRY = '40007'
AND M_40007.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_20005
ON T.BZ = M_20005.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_20005.DICT_ENTRY = '20005'
AND M_20005.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40026
ON T.DDZT = M_40026.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40026.DICT_ENTRY = '40026'
AND M_40026.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40027
ON T.CLBZ = M_40027.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40027.DICT_ENTRY = '40027'
AND M_40027.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40028
ON T.FXCSNL = M_40028.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40028.DICT_ENTRY = '40028'
AND M_40028.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
LEFT JOIN BASE_DATA.TMG_DICT_ENTRY_MAP M_40029
ON T.CPFXPJ = M_40029.PREV_DICT_ENTRY_KEY
AND M_40029.DICT_ENTRY = '40029'
AND M_40029.PREV_SYS = 'TROTC'
left join base_data.tmg_dict_entry_map m_50022 on t2.cpfl = m_50022.prev_dict_entry_key
                                              and m_50022.dict_entry ='50022'
                                              and m_50022.prev_sys='TROTC'       
WHERE T.TX_DATE='${bdp.system.bizdate}'

-- drop table base_sum.t_cust_asset_turnover_rate;
-- create table base_sum.t_cust_asset_turnover_rate(
-- dept_code      string         comment'营业部编码',
-- dept_name      string         comment'营业部名称',
-- staff_code     string         comment'员工编号',
-- staff_name     string         comment'员工名称',
-- cust_no        string         comment'客户号',
-- relation_type  string         comment'关系类型',
-- trans_volume   decimal(30,4)  comment'交易量',
-- asset_total    decimal(30,4)  comment'总资产',
-- turnover_rate  decimal(30,4)  comment'周转率'
-- ) comment '客户资产周转率表'
-- partitioned by (tx_year string)
-- stored as parquet;

insert overwrite table base_sum.t_cust_asset_turnover_rate partition(tx_year)
select 
m2.branch_code dept_no,
m2.branch_name yyb,
       m1.rybh,
       m1.ryxm,
       khh_xc,
       case when gxlx = 10 then '营销关系' when gxlx = 60 then '服务关系' else null end gxlx,
       nvl(a.jyl, 0) jyl,
       nvl(b.yjzzc, 0) zzc,
       a.jyl / b.yjzzc zzl,
       substr(${bdp.system.currmonth},1,4) as tx_year
  from crm_apex.crmii_tkhgx t
  left join crm_apex.crmii_tryxx m1 on m1.id = t.ryxx
  left join base_data.tpt_branch m2 on m2.branch_code = t.yyb
  left join (SELECT A.KHH, SUM((A.CJJE) * B.DHBL) JYL
               FROM (SELECT KHH, BZ, MON, SUM(CJJE) CJJE --近一年成交量
                       FROM crm_apex.DCUSER_T_XC_YCL_ZQJY_Y
                      WHERE tx_month  BETWEEN concat(substr(${bdp.system.currmonth},1,4),'01') AND ${bdp.system.currmonth}
                      GROUP BY KHH, BZ, MON) A,
                    crm_apex.CRMII_THLCS_LS B
              WHERE A.BZ = B.BZ
                AND B.YF = A.MON
              GROUP BY A.KHH) a on a.khh = t.khh_xc
  left join (SELECT KHH, SUM(RJZZC) / count(*) YJZZC --近一年日均总资产
               FROM crm_apex.DSC_STAT_T_STAT_KHZC_Y_DWZQ T
              WHERE tx_date BETWEEN concat(substr(${bdp.system.currmonth},1,4),'01') AND ${bdp.system.currmonth}
                and rjzzc > 0
              GROUP BY KHH) b on b.khh = t.khh_xc
 where yyb not in (1) and m2.branch_code is not null and gxlx in (10,60)
   and jzrq is null
   and b.yjzzc > 0
   and a.jyl > 0
 order by yyb, rybh, zzl desc;

--  历史数据从20170103开始
 INSERT OVERwrite table BASE_DATA.TEV_ENTRUST_OF partition(biz_date='${bdp.system.bizdate}')
--(apply_no,
--branch_code,
--src_branch_code,
--cust_no,
--cap_acct_no,
--fund_acct_no,
--fund_tx_acct_no,
--cust_name,
--ta_code,
--entr_no,
--revoke_flag,
--revoke_apply_no,
--seller,
--fund_code,
--fund_name,
--charge_mode_code,
--tx_date,
--entr_date,
--entr_time,
--sell_site,
--entr_share,
--entr_amt,
--disc_type_code,
--disc_rate,
--curr_code,
--oppo_fund_acct_no,
--oppo_seller,
--oppo_sell_site,
--oppo_fund_code,
--oppo_fund_charge_mode_code,
--tran_reason_code,
--freeze_reason_code,
--freeze_valid_date,
--huge_rede_mode_code,
--divi_mode_code,
--fund_decl_mode_code,
--adv_date,
--entr_state_code,
--confirm_flag,
--entr_mode_code,
--oper_teller,
--oper_site,
--oper_site_mac,
--oper_site_ip,
--oper_site_mobile,
--oper_site_hd,
--oper_site_uuid,
--oper_site_imei,
--oper_source,
--busi_subj,
--biz_time,
--biz_src)
select 
sqbh as apply_no,
coalesce(m_10002.dict_entry_key, concat('', t.yyb)) as branch_code ,
t.yyb as SRC_Branch_Code ,
t.KHH as cust_no,
t.JSZH as Cap_Acct_No,
t.JJZH as Fund_Acct_No,
t.jyzh as fund_tx_acct_no,
t.khxm as cust_name,
t.TADM as Ta_Code,
t.WTH as Entr_No,
COALESCE(M_40001.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.CXBZ)) AS REVOKE_FLAG,
t.YSQBH as Revoke_Apply_No,
t.XSRDM as Seller,
t.JJDM as Fund_Code,
t.JJMC as Fund_Name,
coalesce(m_40015.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.sffs)) as charge_mode_code,
JYRQ as Tx_Date,
WTRQ as Entr_Date,
WTSJ as Entr_Time,
WDH as Sell_Site,
WTFE as Entr_Share,
WTJE as Entr_Amt,
coalesce(m_40017.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.zklx)) as disc_type_code,
ZKL as Disc_Rate,
coalesce(m_20005.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.bz)) as curr_code,
DFJJZH as Oppo_Fund_Acct_No,
DFXSRDM as Oppo_Seller,
DFWDH as Oppo_Sell_Site,
DFJJDM as Oppo_Fund_Code,
coalesce(m_40015_2.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.dfsffs)) as Oppo_Fund_Charge_Mode_code,
coalesce(m_40020.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.ghyy)) as Tran_Reason_Code,
coalesce(m_40021.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.djyy)) as Freeze_Reason_Code,
DJYXRQ as Freeze_Valid_Date,
coalesce(m_40022.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.JESHCLFS)) as Huge_Rede_Mode_Code,
coalesce(m_40016.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.fhfs)) as Divi_Mode_Code,
coalesce(m_40024.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.sbfs)) as fund_Decl_Mode_code,
YYRQ as Adv_Date,
COALESCE(M_40006.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.SBJG)) AS ENTR_STATE_CODE,
coalesce(m_40023.dict_entry_key, concat('?', t.qrbz)) as Confirm_Flag,
COALESCE(M_40007.DICT_ENTRY_KEY,CONCAT('?',T.WTFS)) AS ENTR_MODE_CODE,
t.wtgy as oper_teller,
t.czzd as Oper_Site,
regexp_replace(
case 
--1.1有mac字样开头，考虑存在中间分隔符或者不存在两张情况，末尾必须有分隔符或者字符尾
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(MAC[\\s\\pP\\W])(([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\pP]?){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',2)
--1.2无mac字样开头，考虑中间有分隔符号: (00:00:00:00:00:00  考虑：-|.和空格),并且前后有分隔符（标点、空格、开头和结尾）
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[-]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[|]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[.]){5}|([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\\s]){5})[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))',0)
--1.3无mac字样开头，考虑中间无分隔符号，排除UUID造成的影响
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
     and regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)<>
         regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-])([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',8)
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0)
else ''
end,
'[\\s\\pP\\W]','') as OPER_site_mac,
CASE
--2.1 IP判断有固定前缀的认为他准确
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((IIP:)|(MIP:))(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE
--2.2 IP内网包含10网段 172,16-31,192.168
regexp_extract(
regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),--剔除10,127,172,192,255网段
'((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(([1-9]|1[1-9]|[2-9][0-9]|11[0-9]|12[012345689]|1[3-6][0-9]|17[013456789]|18[0-9]|19[013456789]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-4])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((172)[.]([1]?[0-5]|[3][2-9]|[4-9][0-9]|25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2})[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))|((([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))((192)[.]([1-9]?[0-9]|1[0-5][0-9]|16[012345679]|1[7-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])[.](25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[1][0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9]))(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($)))'
,0)
,'(\\d+.\\d+.\\d+.\\d+)',0)
end as OPER_site_ip,
case 
--3.1手机号优先判断有前缀的记录
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'((MPN:)|(IP:)|(A-)|(I-)|(HSTY))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',7)
--3.2手机号只考虑有前后分隔符
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--3.3手机号考虑特殊情况
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))(1[3-9][0-9]{9})(Z4008)(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
END AS OPER_site_MOBILE,
case 
--4.1硬盘号只考虑带前缀的,后缀只考虑为固定的几种[;,]
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''((HD)|(HDD))(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-zA-Z-_\\s.]+)(([;,])|($))''',6)
else ''
end as OPER_site_hd,
case 
--5.1 ios的uuid考虑有uuid开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(UUID)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(([\\s\\pP\\W])|(^))([0-9a-fA-F]{8}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{4}[-][0-9a-fA-F]{12})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_UUID,
case
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
when length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
then regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(IMEI)(([\\s\\pP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\s\\pP\\W])|($))',4)
else ''
end as OPER_site_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 or length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN length(regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'

WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
when t.czzd rlike '^(172|10|192).\\d+.\\d+.\\d+$'
then '6'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%DZHG%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN 'DZHGB'
when upper(t.czzd) like '%SFJR%' AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN '3'
when (upper(t.czzd) like '%GSFY%' OR upper(t.czzd) like '%股市方圆%') AND upper(t.czzd) NOT like '%AAAAAAAA'

THEN regexp_extract(upper(t.czzd),'''(TYPE[\\s\\pP\\W])([0-9a-zA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)

END AS OPER_SOURCE,

-- name p990000199_v2
-- type Spark SQL
-- author admin@dtstack.com
-- create time 2023-12-25 13:13:57
-- desc 目标表:base_app_glkj.tszl_2  迁移报表，财务报表市占率计算


--清理数据，防止重复计算 hive不支持delete,改用insert OVERWRITE方法
--delete from base_app_glkj.tszl_2
--where fyear=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},1,4) and fmonth=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},5,2);
--执行计算本月各个营业部市占率及本年累计市占率
SET spark.sql.crossjoin.enabled=true ;

insert OVERWRITE table base_app_glkj.tszl_2 partition(fyear,fmonth)
SELECT AA.UNIT_CODE,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS AJJ_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_LJCJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_LJCJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_BNSZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_LJCJJE / 2.0) *100.0/ (BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE*1.0)) END,8) AS AJJ_BNSZL,
       AA.A_CJJE,--本期A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_CJJE,--本期A股+基金成交金额
       AA.A_LJCJJE as A_BNCJJE,--本年累计A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_LJCJJE as AJJ_BNCJJE--本年累计A股+基金成交金额
       ,BB.SC_A_CJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE,
       BB.SC_A_LJCJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE,
       ${bdp.system.bizdate} AS TX_DATE,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4) as fyear,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},5,2) as fmonth
  FROM (select T.UNIT_CODE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE) A_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE + T.JJ_CJJE) AJJ_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE) A_LJCJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE + T.JJ_LJCJJE) AJJ_LJCJJE
          from (
                --经纪
                SELECT a.yyb AS UNIT_CODE,
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM base_sum.tmul_day_rport A
                 WHERE  a.rq>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 GROUP BY a.yyb
                --信用
                union all
                SELECT A.YYB AS UNIT_CODE,
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0','A6','C0','AC','AD','CD','AK','CR','NA','NC','RA','RC','RK','NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0', 'A6', 'C0', 'AC', 'AD', 'CD', 'AK', 'AN', 'RK', 'RN', 'CR', 'NA', 'NC', 'RA', 'RC', 'NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
             ----202101修改 'EA','EB','EC'
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM rmc.DW_TB_RZRQ_TZQJYTJ A
                 where A.khflfs IN (0,1)  --202101修改
                 AND a.biz_date>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 AND A.MARKET_CODE IN ('SH','SZ')--20240207修改
                 GROUP BY A.YYB) T
         GROUP BY T.UNIT_CODE) AA CROSS JOIN
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN --20221128 增加BJ市场
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_CJJE, --市场本期Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) * 10000
                       END ELSE 0 END),
                   0) SC_AJJ_CJJE, --市场本期A+基金成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                              SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_LJCJJE, --市场本年Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                              SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) * 10000
                       END ELSE 0 END),
                   0) SC_AJJ_LJCJJE --市场本年A+基金成交金额
          FROM RMDC.sc61_tb_dbf_sccj A
          WHERE a.rq>=cast(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') as int) AND a.JYS IN ('SZ','SH')
        ) BB ON 1=1; --市场成交金额

-- name 客户交易频率收益率
-- type Spark SQL
-- author linghuan@dwzq.com
-- create time 2024-04-19 15:27:59
-- desc 
1、交易频率公司客户人数分布：按月均交易天数，2024年、2023年，中位数、平均数
2、持仓收益率公司客户人数分布：按月均收益率，2024年、2023年，中位数、平均数
3、登录秀财APP天数客户人数分布：按月均登录天数，2024年、2023年，中位数、平均数
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
按年汇总，客户A的交易频率=客户A全年的交易天数/有交易的月份数
客户A的月均收益率=客户每个月的收益率/有收益率的月份数
客户A的月均访问APP天数=客户A全年的访问APP天数/有访问APP的月份数


--1.计算每位客户：月份、交易天数、交易笔数
--基础表-客户行为-客户交易频率（有交易月的交易天数）
select a2.*,trade_days/trade_months as trade_freq
from
(select cust_no,trade_year,count(distinct biz_date) as trade_days,
                           count(distinct trade_month) as trade_months,
						   count(distinct SEQU_NO) as trade_cnt
FROM
(select '3.tev_sett' as tname,biz_date,CUST_NO,SEQU_NO,substr(biz_date,1,4) as trade_year,substr(biz_date,1,6) as trade_month
from base_data.tev_sett
where BIZ_DATE >= '20230101' and busi_subj in ('1','2','5','36','126','59','60','78','79','178','179')

union all
select '4.tev_sett_CRDT' as tname,biz_date,CUST_NO,SEQU_NO,substr(biz_date,1,4) as trade_year,substr(biz_date,1,6) as trade_month
from base_data.tev_sett_CRDT
where BIZ_DATE >= '20230101' and busi_subj in ('1','2','5','36','126','59','60','61','62','63','64','71','72','78','79','178','179'))a1
group by cust_no,trade_year)a2

--2. 计算每位客户：月份、持仓收益率
--筛选期初总资产>0的客户
select a2.*,pal_sum/pal_month as pal
from
(select pal_year,khh,sum(ykl) as pal_sum,
                     count(distinct yf) as pal_month
from
(select yf,khh,ykl,substr(yf,1,4) as pal_year
from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_y
where yf>=202301 and QCZZC>0)a1
group by pal_year,khh)a2


--3.计算每位客户：月份、访问天数
select deal_account,app_year,app_days,app_months,app_days/app_months as app_freq
from
(select deal_account,app_year,count(distinct app_date) as app_days,
                              count(distinct app_month) as app_months
from
(select deal_account,`date` as app_date,substr(`date`,1,4) as app_year,substr(`date`,1,7) as app_month
from base_sum.t_user_active_his
where `date`>='2023-01-01' and deal_account!='')a1
group by deal_account,app_year)a2



--1.计算客户月均交易次数的十分位分布
select trade_year,
count(distinct cust_no) as custs,
percentile(trade_freq,0.0) as p0, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.1) as p1, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.2) as p2, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.3) as p3, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.4) as p4, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.5) as p5, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.6) as p6, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.7) as p7, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.8) as p8, 
percentile(trade_freq,0.9) as p9, 
percentile(trade_freq,1.0) as p10
from 
(

select a2.*,trade_days/trade_months as trade_freq
from
(select cust_no,trade_year,count(distinct biz_date) as trade_days,
                           count(distinct trade_month) as trade_months,
						   count(distinct SEQU_NO) as trade_cnt
FROM
(select '3.tev_sett' as tname,biz_date,CUST_NO,SEQU_NO,substr(biz_date,1,4) as trade_year,substr(biz_date,1,6) as trade_month
from base_data.tev_sett
where BIZ_DATE >= '20230101' and busi_subj in ('1','2','5','36','126','59','60','78','79','178','179')

union all
select '4.tev_sett_CRDT' as tname,biz_date,CUST_NO,SEQU_NO,substr(biz_date,1,4) as trade_year,substr(biz_date,1,6) as trade_month
from base_data.tev_sett_CRDT
where BIZ_DATE >= '20230101' and busi_subj in ('1','2','5','36','126','59','60','61','62','63','64','71','72','78','79','178','179'))a1
group by cust_no,trade_year)a2

)t1
group by trade_year




--2.计算客户月均盈亏的十分位分布
select pal_year,
count(distinct khh) as custs,
percentile(pal,0.0) as p0, 
percentile(pal,0.1) as p1, 
percentile(pal,0.2) as p2, 
percentile(pal,0.3) as p3, 
percentile(pal,0.4) as p4, 
percentile(pal,0.5) as p5, 
percentile(pal,0.6) as p6, 
percentile(pal,0.7) as p7, 
percentile(pal,0.8) as p8, 
percentile(pal,0.9) as p9, 
percentile(pal,1.0) as p10
from 
(
select a2.*,pal_sum/pal_month as pal
from
(select pal_year,khh,sum(ykl) as pal_sum,
                     count(distinct yf) as pal_month
from
(select yf,khh,ykl,substr(yf,1,4) as pal_year
from adp_dm.ids_t_stat_zd_y
where yf>=202301 and QCZZC>=10000 and QMZZC >= 10000)a1
group by pal_year,khh)a2

)t1
group by pal_year



--3.计算客户月均访问天数的十分位分布
select app_year,
count(distinct deal_account) as custs,
percentile(app_freq,0.0) as p0, 
percentile(app_freq,0.1) as p1, 
percentile(app_freq,0.2) as p2, 
percentile(app_freq,0.3) as p3, 
percentile(app_freq,0.4) as p4, 
percentile(app_freq,0.5) as p5, 
percentile(app_freq,0.6) as p6, 
percentile(app_freq,0.7) as p7, 
percentile(app_freq,0.8) as p8, 
percentile(app_freq,0.9) as p9, 
percentile(app_freq,1.0) as p10
from 
(
select deal_account,app_year,app_days,app_months,app_days/app_months as app_freq
from
(select deal_account,app_year,count(distinct app_date) as app_days,
                              count(distinct app_month) as app_months
from
(select deal_account,`date` as app_date,substr(`date`,1,4) as app_year,substr(`date`,1,7) as app_month
from base_sum.t_user_active_his
where `date`>='2023-01-01' and deal_account!='')a1
group by deal_account,app_year)a2

)t1
group by app_year

select
	t4.branch_code as `营业部代码`,
	t5.branch_name as `营业部名称`,
	t3.cust_no as `客户号`,
	t4.open_date as `开户日期`,
	t4.cust_full_name as `本地客户名称`,
    t4.CERT_NO as `本地证件号码`,
	t1.khmc as `中登客户全称`,
	t1.zjdm as `中登证件号码`,
	case when t1.jglb='10' then '证券公司' 
	 when t1.jglb='11' then '银行' 
	 when t1.jglb='12' then '信托投资公司' 
	 when t1.jglb='13' then '基金管理公司' 
	 when t1.jglb='14' then '保险公司' 
	 when t1.jglb='31' then '境外一般机构' end  as `机构类别`,
	t1.ymth as `一码通账号`
from
	(
	select
		khmc,
		zjlb,
		zjdm,
		ymth,
		jglb,
		tx_date
	from
		csdc.qtymtzl
	where
		khlb='1' and jglb in ('10', '11','12','13','14','31')) t1
inner join csdc.qtzhzl t2 on
	t1.ymth = t2.ymth
inner join BASE_DATA.TAC_SEC_ACCT t3 on
	t2.zqzh = t3.SEC_ACCT_NO
inner join BASE_DATA.TPT_CUST t4 on
	t3.cust_no = t4.cust_no
inner join base_data.tpt_branch t5 on

WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(UUID)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0

--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''

CASE
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(IMEI)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0

ELSE ''
END AS OPER_SITE_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 OR LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(TO'';''TEL)',0))<>0

WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'

WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
WHEN T.CZZD RLIKE '^(172|10|192).\\D+.\\D+.\\D+$'

WHEN UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%DZHG%' AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA'

--5.2 考虑格式满足的比较特殊不容易误截取
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(([\\S\\PP\\W])|(^))([0-9A-FA-F]{8}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{4}[-][0-9A-FA-F]{12})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''
END AS	OPER_SITE_UUID,
CASE
--6.1 安卓的IMEI考虑有开头
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(IMEI)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',0))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(IMEI)(([\\S\\PP\\W]))([0-9]{15})(([\\S\\PP\\W])|($))',4)
ELSE ''
END AS	OPER_SITE_IMEI,
CASE 
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'([0-9]+(Z4008)($))',0))<>0 OR LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TO;TEL)''',0))<>0
THEN '1'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HSTY[0-9]+)',0))<>0
THEN '2'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'(^HH[_])',0))<>0
THEN '3'
WHEN T.WTFS='8' OR UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%127.0.0.1%'
THEN '4'
WHEN T.WTFS='2'
THEN '5'
WHEN T.WTFS='4'
THEN '6'
WHEN T.CZZD RLIKE '^(172|10|192).\\D+.\\D+.\\D+$'
THEN '6'
WHEN UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%DZHG%' AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN 'DZHGB'
WHEN UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%SFJR%' AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA'
THEN '3'
WHEN (UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%GSFY%' OR UPPER(T.CZZD) LIKE '%股市方圆%') AND UPPER(T.CZZD) NOT LIKE '%AAAAAAAA' 
THEN 'GSFY'
WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TYPE[\\S\\PP\\W])([0-9A-ZA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2))<>0
THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(T.CZZD),'''(TYPE[\\S\\PP\\W])([0-9A-ZA-Z_]+)(([;,@-])|($))''',2)
ELSE ''
END AS	OPER_SOURCE,

select ttt1.s_info_compname as `上市公司名称`,
    ttt1.s_info_code `证券代码`,
    ttt1.s_info_name `证券名称`,
    ttt1.s_dq_mv `流通市值`,
    ttt1.s_holder_name `股东名称`,
    ttt1.s_holder_pct `持股比例`,
    ttt1.s_holder_quantity `持股数`,
    ttt1.s_holder_restrictedquantity `持有限售股份数量` ,ttt4.branch_name `开户营业部`,ttt3.stf_name `客户经理` from (
select
    tt1.s_info_compname ,
    tt1.s_info_code ,
    tt1.s_info_name ,
    tt1.s_dq_mv ,
    tt2.s_holder_name ,
    tt2.s_holder_pct ,
    tt2.s_holder_quantity ,
    tt2.s_holder_restrictedquantity 
from
    ( select
        x.s_info_windcode,
        x.s_info_compname,
        x.s_info_code,
        x.s_info_name,
        y.s_dq_mv 
    from
        wind.wind_asharedescription x,
        (  select
            t1.s_info_windcode,
            t1.s_dq_mv  
        from
            wind.wind_ashareeodderivativeindicator t1,
            (   select
                a.s_info_windcode,
                max(trade_dt) as trade_dt   
            from
                wind.wind_ashareeodderivativeindicator a 
            where
                a.s_dq_mv is not null 
            group by
                a.s_info_windcode) t2  
        where
            t1.s_info_windcode = t2.s_info_windcode   
            and t1.trade_dt = t2.trade_dt
        ) y 
    where
        x.s_info_windcode = y.s_info_windcode 
    ) tt1 
inner join
    (
        select
            b.s_info_windcode,
            b.s_holder_name ,
            b.s_holder_pct ,
            b.s_holder_quantity ,
            b.s_holder_restrictedquantity  
        from
            wind.wind_ashareinsideholder b ,
            ( select
                a.s_info_windcode ,
                max(a.report_period) report_period 
            from
                wind.wind_ashareinsideholder a 
            where
                a.report_period is not null
            group by
                a.s_info_windcode ) c 
        where
            b.s_info_windcode=c.s_info_windcode 
             and b.report_period=c.report_period
            and b.s_holder_holdercategory =2
        ) tt2 
            on tt1.s_info_windcode=tt2.s_info_windcode order by
        tt1.s_dq_mv desc) ttt1 inner join (select khqc,yyb,nvl(stf_id_10,nvl(stf_id_60,stf_id_80)) as stf_id from dmp_tmp_tabs.dmp_cust_base_info where jgbz=1 and khzt=0) ttt2
        on ttt1.s_holder_name=ttt2.khqc
        left join base_data.tpt_staff ttt3 on ttt2.stf_id=ttt3.stf_id
        left join base_data.tpt_branch ttt4 on ttt2.yyb=ttt4.branch_code;

-- name test1014
-- type Spark SQL
-- author qiaotianguo@dwzq.com

-- desc 
-- name p990000199_v2
-- type Spark SQL

-- desc 目标表:base_app_glkj.tszl_2  迁移报表，财务报表市占率计算


--清理数据，防止重复计算 hive不支持delete,改用insert OVERWRITE方法
--delete from base_app_glkj.tszl_2
--where fyear=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},1,4) and fmonth=SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.bizdate},5,2);
--执行计算本月各个营业部市占率及本年累计市占率
-- SET spark.sql.crossjoin.enabled=true ; 
alter table base_app_glkj.tszl_2 drop if exists partition (fyear=2025,fmonth=9);

insert OVERWRITE table base_app_glkj.tszl_2 partition(fyear,fmonth)
SELECT AA.UNIT_CODE,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_CJJE / 2) / BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE)*100 END,8) AS AJJ_SZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_A_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.A_LJCJJE / 2) / BB.SC_A_LJCJJE)*100 END,8) AS A_BNSZL,
       round(CASE WHEN BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE=0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AA.AJJ_LJCJJE / 2.0) *100.0/ (BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE*1.0)) END,8) AS AJJ_BNSZL,
       AA.A_CJJE,--本期A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_CJJE,--本期A股+基金成交金额
       AA.A_LJCJJE as A_BNCJJE,--本年累计A股成交金额
       AA.AJJ_LJCJJE as AJJ_BNCJJE--本年累计A股+基金成交金额
       ,BB.SC_A_CJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_CJJE,
       BB.SC_A_LJCJJE,
       BB.SC_AJJ_LJCJJE,
       ${bdp.system.bizdate} AS TX_DATE,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4) as fyear,
       SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},5,2) as fmonth
  FROM (select T.UNIT_CODE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE) A_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_CJJE + T.JJ_CJJE) AJJ_CJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE) A_LJCJJE,
               SUM(T.A_LJCJJE + T.JJ_LJCJJE) AJJ_LJCJJE
          from (
                --经纪
                SELECT b.map_branch_code AS UNIT_CODE,
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjea
                              else
                               0
                            end) as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                        sum(case
                              when SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                   SUBSTRING(A.RQ, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                               A.cjjejj
                              else
                               0
                            end) as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM base_sum.tmul_day_rport A
                  --20240409修改by-zj:一些取消的网络营业部被代管，需要关联营业部代管映射表
                  left join rmdc.GLKJ_FZJG_BRANCH_MAP B on a.yyb=b.branch_code
                 WHERE  a.rq>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 GROUP BY b.map_branch_code
                --信用
                union all
                SELECT b.map_branch_code AS UNIT_CODE,
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0','A6','C0','AC','AD','CD','AK','CR','NA','NC','RA','RC','RK','NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_cjje, --A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                               CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_cjje, --基金成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN
                  ('A0', 'A6', 'C0', 'AC', 'AD', 'CD', 'AK', 'AN', 'RK', 'RN', 'CR', 'NA', 'NC', 'RA', 'RC', 'NK') AND
                  JYLB IN
                  (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72, 78, 79, 178, 179) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END  else 0 end) / 10000 as a_ljcjje, --本年累计A股成交金额
                       sum(case
                             when SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                                  SUBSTRING(A.biz_date, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                              CASE
             WHEN ZQLB IN ('T0', 'E0', 'L0', 'EZ', 'EH', 'J1','EA','EB','EC') AND
             ----202101修改 'EA','EB','EC'
                  JYLB IN (1, 2, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 71, 72) THEN
              COALESCE(CJJE,0)
             ELSE
              0
           END else 0 end) / 10000 as jj_ljcjje --本年累计基金成交金额
                  FROM rmc.DW_TB_RZRQ_TZQJYTJ A
                   --20240409修改by-zj:一些取消的网络营业部被代管，需要关联营业部代管映射表
                  left join rmdc.GLKJ_FZJG_BRANCH_MAP B on a.yyb=b.branch_code
                 where A.khflfs IN (0,1)  --202101修改
                 AND a.biz_date>=CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
                 AND A.MARKET_CODE IN ('SH','SZ')--20240207修改
                 GROUP BY b.map_branch_code) T
         GROUP BY T.UNIT_CODE) AA CROSS JOIN
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN --20221128 增加BJ市场
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_CJJE, --市场本期Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) = SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) * 10000
                       END ELSE 0 END),
                   0) SC_AJJ_CJJE, --市场本期A+基金成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                              SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB) * 10000
                       END else 0 end),
                   0) AS SC_A_LJCJJE, --市场本年Ａ股成交金额
               COALESCE(SUM(case
                         when SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) <= SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,6) and
                              SUBSTRING(A.rq, 1, 6) >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'01') then
                          CASE
                         WHEN A.JYS IN ('SZ' ) THEN
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) / 10000
                         ELSE
                          (A.CJJEA+a.CJJEZXB+a.CJJECYB + A.CJJEJJ) * 10000
                       END ELSE 0 END),
                   0) SC_AJJ_LJCJJE --市场本年A+基金成交金额
          FROM RMDC.sc61_tb_dbf_sccj A
          WHERE a.rq>=cast(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') as int) AND a.JYS IN ('SZ','SH')
        ) BB ON 1=1; --市场成交金额

	and cust_type_code = '0'		--个人客户

SELECT t.cust_no
	,cast(SUBSTR(birthday,5,2) as int) as birthmonth	--出生月份
	,age									--年龄,有缺失需均值填充
	,cast(nvl(sex_code,'0') as int)	as 	sex				--性别，0表示未知
	,case when educ_code in ('1','2')   then 4 	--硕士、博士
		when educ_code in ('3','4','5') then 3	--大学、大专、中专
		when educ_code = '6'            then 2	--高中
		when educ_code = '7'            then 1	--初中及其以下
		else 0 end  as educ_level				--其他或者未知学历
	,case when career_code in ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '14', '16', '17', '18', '33', '34', '-2') then 1 else 0 end as career_gov	--行政相关职业
	,case when career_code in ('6', '7', '8', '9', '10', '11', '38', '-1')  then 1 else 0 end as career_sci		--科教相关职业
	,case when career_code in ('12', '13', '24', '25') then 1 else 0 end as career_finance		--金融相关职业
	,case when career_code in ('15', '19', '20', '21', '22', '23', '26', '27', '28', '29', '30', '31', '32', '36') then 1 else 0 end as career_business 	--工商相关职业
	,case when career_code in ('35', '37') then 1 else 0 end as career_unemployed  --退休和无业
	,case when career_code = '99' or career_code is null then 1 else 0 end as career_other 	--其他职业
	,case when substr(b.branch_name,1,2) = '苏州' then 1 else 0 end as if_suzhou		--分支机构是否属于苏州
	,case when open_mode_code is null then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_0		--未知开户类型
	,case when open_mode_code = '1' then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_1		--临柜开户
	,case when open_mode_code = '2' then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_2		--双人见证
	,case when open_mode_code = '3' then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_3		--网上双向视频开户
	,case when open_mode_code = '4' then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_4		--视频见证
	,case when open_mode_code = '5' then 1 else 0 end as open_mode_code_5		--网上单向视频开户
	,cast(SUBSTR('2025-01-01',1,4) as int) - cast(SUBSTR(open_date,1,4) as int) as open_years		--开户年限，已统计时间为准
	,cast(SUBSTR(open_date,5,2) as int) as open_month		--开户月份
	,case when close_date IS NOT NULL and close_date <= 20241231 and datediff(close_date,open_date) >=0 then 1 else 0 
		end as if_close  --是否销过户
	,case when cust_limit_codes is not null then length(cust_limit_codes) - length(REPLACE(cust_limit_codes,"\\;",'')) + 1 else 0 end as cust_limit_cnt		--客户限制数量
	,cast(aml_lvl_code as int) as aml_lvl   --反洗钱等级
